---
title: "OLD vs NEW: the comparison of the two datasets (plan T6)"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

What this file does (plan T6; results and their reading in
`docs/results/old-vs-new.md`, commands and outputs in
`docs/tests/T6-results.md`):

* (a, item 6) the data: shoes, RACs, contact surface, RAC density and RAC type
  per dataset; (b) the contours and the step-2 distances;
* (c, items 2-3) the models: sigma^2 without and with the offset, the fixed
  effects on the common (OLD) basis with their z-differences, equality Wald
  tests, and the all-spatial Wald test of each dataset;
* (d, item 1) the maps on the common prototype grid on one colour scale, with
  the difference and the ratio, for both models, and the sensitivities of the
  plan (common basis, full tensor, finer y knots, NEW without the reprinted
  shoes, NEW without group A);
* (e, item 4) the confidence intervals at the cuts (rows 110, 190, 250) of
  both datasets on the same axes;
* (item 5) the within- and between-area ratios in Naomi's 14 areas;
* (g) the Random - CML difference of each dataset.

Added by the T6 review fixes: the shoe-bootstrap bands and |z| maps in two
versions, the absolute density (each draw recalibrated on its own resampled
shoes, so the overall level's sampling error is in) and the shape (each map
divided by its dataset's observed RAC density); the shares of the prototype
that differ, also away from the K8-pinned edges; a model-free table of RAC
density by region with whole-shoe bootstrap intervals; a model-free
bootstrap of the sigma^2 comparison (the moment estimator of plan F82); the
RAC-level type cross-tabulation on the reprinted soles; the area ratios on
every basis, with shoe-bootstrap intervals where draws exist (the full
tensors got their own bootstraps); the equality tests labelled by whether
their samples are independent (without the reprints: the primary test).

Run from `statistical_model/`, after `tools/fit_compare_models.R` has written
its fits (the list of jobs is in that file):
`Rscript -e 'rmarkdown::render("compare_old_new_7.Rmd", output_dir = "../logs/knit/compare", intermediates_dir = tempdir())'`.
A missing fit stops the run. Only for development, `T6_ALLOW_MISSING=1` knits
with the fits that exist and skips (and lists) every comparison whose fits
are missing; the committed outputs come from a run without it.
Every output is a new file built from both datasets: `processed_data/compare/*_old_vs_new.csv`,
`model_images/compare/*_old_vs_new.pdf` and the PNG copies `docs/qa/T6/*_old_vs_new.png`.

```{r t6_setup}
t_start <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
ROOT_PATH <- paste(dirname(getwd()), "/", sep = "")
for (f in c("profile.R", "io.R", "compare.R", "compare_old_new.R")) {
  source(paste(ROOT_PATH, "statistical_model/R/", f, sep = ""))
}
suppressMessages({
  library(splines)
  library(lme4)
  library(survival)
  library(ggplot2)
})
P_old <- rac_profile("old", root = ROOT_PATH)
P_new <- rac_profile("new", root = ROOT_PATH)
PS <- list(old = P_old, new = P_new)
set.seed(P_old$r$seed) # the parametric simulations below (the OLD profile's seed)
px_per_unit <- P_old$prototype$coords$rel_col_shoe / P_old$prototype$coords$rel_Y_cord
cut_rows <- c(110, 190, 250) # the CI cuts of step 5 (prototype rows)
# colours (validated for colour-vision deficiency with the dataviz palette
# validator: OLD blue, NEW orange, the third series aqua with direct labels)
COL <- c(old = "#2a78d6", new = "#eb6834", norep = "#1baf7a", groupB = "#6250d6")
SEQ <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(c("#cde2fb", "#9ec5f4", "#6da7ec", "#3987e5",
                                     "#256abf", "#184f95", "#0d366b"))(120)
DIV <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(c("#0d366b", "#256abf", "#6da7ec", "#b7d3f6",
                                     "#f0efec", "#f4c2bd", "#e8817b", "#c93a39",
                                     "#7a1c1c"))(121)
INK <- "#0b0b0b"
INK2 <- "#52514e"
GRID_COL <- "#e1e0d9"
dpi <- 144
out_csv <- function(x, stem) {
  path <- rac_ensure_dir(t6_compare_path(P_old, "csv", stem))
  con <- file(path, "wb")
  on.exit(close(con))
  utils::write.csv(x, con, row.names = FALSE, eol = "\n")
  invisible(path)
}
save_fig <- function(stem, width, height, draw) {
  pdf_path <- rac_ensure_dir(t6_compare_path(P_old, "pdf", stem))
  png_path <- rac_ensure_dir(t6_compare_path(P_old, "png", stem))
  grDevices::pdf(pdf_path, width = width, height = height)
  draw()
  grDevices::dev.off()
  grDevices::png(png_path, width = width, height = height, units = "in",
                 res = dpi, type = "cairo")
  draw()
  grDevices::dev.off()
  cat("figure:", basename(pdf_path), "and", basename(png_path), "\n")
  invisible(png_path)
}
theme_t6 <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = GRID_COL, linewidth = 0.3),
          axis.text = element_text(colour = INK2),
          axis.title = element_text(colour = INK),
          strip.text = element_text(colour = INK, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
          legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(colour = INK, face = "bold"),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = INK2),
          plot.caption = element_text(colour = INK2, hjust = 0),
          plot.title.position = "plot", plot.caption.position = "plot")
}
# subtitles and captions of the ggplot figures, wrapped to the figure width
# (about 12 characters per inch at the theme's text size)
wrap_txt <- function(x, width_in) paste(strwrap(x, width = floor(11 * width_in)), collapse = "\n")
```

## Inputs

```{r t6_inputs}
read_step2 <- function(P) {
  d <- read.csv(rac_path(P, "dataCC_distance"), header = TRUE)
  subset(d, select = c("n_Acc", "x", "y", "shoe", "row_number", "horiz_dist",
                       "new_x", "min_dist", "distance_shape"))
}
D <- lapply(PS, read_step2)
CODES <- lapply(PS, function(P) read.csv(rac_path(P, "shoe_codes"), header = TRUE))
PC <- lapply(PS, function(P) read.csv(rac_path(P, "pixel_counts"), header = TRUE))
LOC <- lapply(PS, read_locations)
MEAN_OFFSET <- vapply(PS, function(P) {
  mean(log(P$r$n_controls / read.csv(rac_path(P, "pixel_counts"))$pixel_count))
}, 0)
stopifnot(identical(CODES$new$code, CODES$new$shoe))
reprints <- t6_reprint_ids(ROOT_PATH)
group_a <- CODES$new$shoe[t6_group_a(CODES$new$shoe)]
n_shoes <- vapply(D, function(d) length(unique(d$shoe)), 0L)
cat(sprintf("shoes: OLD %d, NEW %d; NEW reprint or uncertain (T0 review): %d; NEW group A: %d\n",
            n_shoes[["old"]], n_shoes[["new"]], length(reprints), length(group_a)))
print(MEAN_OFFSET, digits = 10)

# the fits: committed step-3 models (own bases), the NEW refits on the OLD
# basis (T5, A-112), the offset refits and the T6 sensitivity fits
# (tools/fit_compare_models.R)
allow_missing <- identical(Sys.getenv("T6_ALLOW_MISSING"), "1")
skipped <- character(0)
need <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    stop("missing fit ", path, ": run tools/fit_compare_models.R first",
         call. = FALSE)
  }
  path
}
optional <- function(path) {
  if (file.exists(path)) return(readRDS(path))
  if (!allow_missing) need(path)
  skipped <<- c(skipped, sub(ROOT_PATH, "", path, fixed = TRUE))
  NULL
}
have <- function(...) all(c(...) %in% names(FIT))
model_summary <- function(path, label, data, offset_refit = FALSE) {
  m <- readRDS(need(path))
  if (inherits(m, "merMod")) stopifnot(nobs(m) == nrow(data))
  if (inherits(m, "coxph")) stopifnot(m$n == nrow(data))
  s <- t6_from_model(m, label, data)
  s$offset_refit <- offset_refit
  if (inherits(m, "merMod")) {
    s$vcov_default <- as.matrix(vcov(m))  # the stored Hessian if any (K11)
    dimnames(s$vcov_default) <- dimnames(s$vcov)
  }
  rm(m)
  invisible(gc())
  s
}
t6_record <- function(P, stem) optional(t6_fit_path(P, stem))
FIT <- list(
  glmm_old = model_summary(rac_model_path(P_old, "NEW_X_NS_XY"), "OLD GLMM", D$old),
  cml_old = model_summary(rac_model_path(P_old, "CML_MODEL"), "OLD CML", D$old),
  glmm_new = model_summary(rac_model_path(P_new, "NEW_X_NS_XY"), "NEW GLMM", D$new),
  cml_new = model_summary(rac_model_path(P_new, "CML_MODEL"), "NEW CML", D$new),
  glmm_new_ob = model_summary(rac_model_path(P_new, "NEW_X_NS_XY_oldbasis"),
                              "NEW GLMM, OLD basis", D$new),
  cml_new_ob = model_summary(rac_model_path(P_new, "CML_MODEL_oldbasis"),
                             "NEW CML, OLD basis", D$new),
  off_old = model_summary(rac_model_path(P_old, "NEW_X_NS_XY_offset"),
                          "OLD GLMM with offset", D$old, offset_refit = TRUE),
  off_new = model_summary(rac_model_path(P_new, "NEW_X_NS_XY_offset"),
                          "NEW GLMM with offset", D$new, offset_refit = TRUE))
stems <- list(old = c(glmm_full = "NEW_X_NS_XY_full", cml_full = "CML_MODEL_full",
                      glmm_fineY0 = "NEW_X_NS_XY_fineY_nagq0",
                      glmm_nagq0 = "NEW_X_NS_XY_nagq0"),
              new = c(glmm_full = "NEW_X_NS_XY_full", cml_full = "CML_MODEL_full",
                      glmm_fineY0 = "NEW_X_NS_XY_fineY_nagq0",
                      glmm_fineYold0 = "NEW_X_NS_XY_fineYold_nagq0",
                      glmm_nagq0 = "NEW_X_NS_XY_nagq0",
                      glmm_norep = "NEW_X_NS_XY_oldbasis_norep",
                      cml_norep = "CML_MODEL_oldbasis_norep",
                      glmm_groupB = "NEW_X_NS_XY_oldbasis_groupB",
                      cml_groupB = "CML_MODEL_oldbasis_groupB",
                      off_norep = "NEW_X_NS_XY_offset_oldbasis_norep"))
for (ds in names(stems)) {
  for (k in names(stems[[ds]])) {
    FIT[[paste(k, ds, sep = "_")]] <- t6_record(PS[[ds]], stems[[ds]][[k]])
  }
}
# the exact CMLs on the finer y basis (84 coefficients) take 1-2 h and about
# 3.5 GB each (survival's exact method; plan T6, A-119): they enter the CML
# figures when their fits exist, and the run lists them when they do not
# (the finer-y sensitivity itself is always there through the GLMMs, nAGQ 0)
slow_missing <- character(0)
slow_cml <- list(old = c(cml_fineY = "CML_MODEL_fineY"),
                 new = c(cml_fineY = "CML_MODEL_fineY", cml_fineYold = "CML_MODEL_fineYold"))
for (ds in names(slow_cml)) {
  for (k in names(slow_cml[[ds]])) {
    p <- t6_fit_path(PS[[ds]], slow_cml[[ds]][[k]])
    if (file.exists(p)) {
      FIT[[paste(k, ds, sep = "_")]] <- readRDS(p)
    } else {
      slow_missing <- c(slow_missing, sub(ROOT_PATH, "", p, fixed = TRUE))
    }
  }
}
# the GLMMs on the finer y basis with nAGQ = 1, if their (long) fits finished
# (otherwise the finer-y GLMM maps use the nAGQ = 0 fits, checked against
# nAGQ = 1 on the step-3 basis in the chunk t6_nagq0)
fine1 <- list(old = c(fineY = "NEW_X_NS_XY_fineY"),
              new = c(fineY = "NEW_X_NS_XY_fineY", fineYold = "NEW_X_NS_XY_fineYold"))
for (ds in names(fine1)) {
  for (k in names(fine1[[ds]])) {
    p <- t6_fit_path(PS[[ds]], fine1[[ds]][[k]])
    if (file.exists(p)) FIT[[paste("glmm", k, ds, sep = "_")]] <- readRDS(p)
  }
}
# readable labels of the T6 fits (their records carry the file stem)
nice <- c(glmm_full = "GLMM, full tensor", cml_full = "CML, full tensor",
          cml_fineY = "CML, finer y", cml_fineYold = "CML, OLD's finer y",
          glmm_fineY0 = "GLMM, finer y (nAGQ 0)", glmm_fineYold0 = "GLMM, OLD's finer y (nAGQ 0)",
          glmm_fineY = "GLMM, finer y", glmm_fineYold = "GLMM, OLD's finer y",
          glmm_nagq0 = "GLMM, nAGQ 0", glmm_norep = "GLMM, no reprints, OLD basis",
          cml_norep = "CML, no reprints, OLD basis", glmm_groupB = "GLMM, group B, OLD basis",
          cml_groupB = "CML, group B, OLD basis",
          off_norep = "GLMM with offset, no reprints, OLD basis")
for (nm in names(FIT)) {
  k <- sub("_(old|new)$", "", nm)
  if (k %in% names(nice)) FIT[[nm]]$label <- paste(toupper(sub("^.*_", "", nm)), nice[[k]])
}
# every fit is tied to the step-2 rows of its shoes (a stale fit fails here)
data_of <- function(fit, ds) D[[ds]][D[[ds]]$shoe %in% fit$shoes, ]
ds_of <- function(nm) if (endsWith(nm, "_old")) "old" else "new"
for (nm in names(FIT)) {
  f <- FIT[[nm]]
  d <- data_of(f, ds_of(nm))
  stopifnot(f$nobs == nrow(d), f$n_cases == sum(d$n_Acc))
}
# the shoe bootstraps of the GLMMs (PIRLS surrogate at the fit's theta,
# tools/fit_compare_models.R boot_*): OLD on its own step-3 basis, NEW (all,
# and without the reprints) on the OLD basis, the common basis of the
# coefficient comparison
BOOT <- list(old = optional(t6_fit_path(P_old, "NEW_X_NS_XY_bootpirls")),
             new_ob = optional(t6_fit_path(P_new, "NEW_X_NS_XY_oldbasis_bootpirls")),
             norep = optional(t6_fit_path(P_new, "NEW_X_NS_XY_oldbasis_norep_bootpirls")))
boot_fit <- c(old = "glmm_old", new_ob = "glmm_new_ob", norep = "glmm_norep_new")
for (k in names(BOOT)) {
  if (is.null(BOOT[[k]]) || !have(boot_fit[[k]])) {
    BOOT[[k]] <- NULL
    next
  }
  r <- BOOT[[k]]
  f <- FIT[[boot_fit[[k]]]]
  stopifnot(identical(r$spec[-1], f$spec[-1]), ncol(r$ids) == length(f$shoes),
            all(r$ids %in% f$shoes))
  t6_boot_draws(r, f)
  cat(sprintf("bootstrap %s: %d draws (%d failed), seed %d, theta %.6f, %.0f s, |beta_pirls(all) - fit| max %.2g\n",
              k, nrow(r$draws), length(r$failed), r$seed, r$theta, r$seconds,
              max(abs(r$beta_all - r$coef))))
}
# the shoe bootstraps of the full tensors (each dataset on its own step-3
# knots, no K8 pin): the intervals of Naomi's area ratios (T6 review fixes)
BOOT_FULL <- list(old = optional(t6_fit_path(P_old, "NEW_X_NS_XY_full_bootpirls")),
                  new = optional(t6_fit_path(P_new, "NEW_X_NS_XY_full_bootpirls")))
for (k in names(BOOT_FULL)) {
  nm <- paste("glmm_full", k, sep = "_")
  if (is.null(BOOT_FULL[[k]]) || !have(nm)) {
    BOOT_FULL[[k]] <- NULL
    next
  }
  r <- BOOT_FULL[[k]]
  f <- FIT[[nm]]
  stopifnot(identical(r$spec[-1], f$spec[-1]), ncol(r$ids) == length(f$shoes),
            all(r$ids %in% f$shoes))
  t6_boot_draws(r, f)
  cat(sprintf("bootstrap full_%s: %d draws (%d failed), seed %d, theta %.6f, %.0f s, |beta_pirls(all) - fit| max %.2g\n",
              k, nrow(r$draws), length(r$failed), r$seed, r$theta, r$seconds,
              max(abs(r$beta_all - r$coef))))
}
# profile-likelihood intervals of sigma^2 (tools/fit_compare_models.R profile_*)
PROF <- list(glmm_old = optional(t6_fit_path(P_old, "profile_NEW_X_NS_XY")),
             glmm_new = optional(t6_fit_path(P_new, "profile_NEW_X_NS_XY")),
             off_old = optional(t6_fit_path(P_old, "profile_NEW_X_NS_XY_offset")),
             off_new = optional(t6_fit_path(P_new, "profile_NEW_X_NS_XY_offset")),
             glmm_norep_new = optional(t6_fit_path(P_new, "profile_NEW_X_NS_XY_oldbasis_norep")),
             off_norep_new = optional(t6_fit_path(P_new, "profile_NEW_X_NS_XY_offset_oldbasis_norep")))
PROF <- PROF[!vapply(PROF, is.null, TRUE)]
for (k in names(PROF)) {
  if (!have(k) || abs(PROF[[k]]$theta_hat - FIT[[k]]$theta) > 1e-10) {
    stop("profile ", k, " does not belong to the fit ", k, call. = FALSE)
  }
}
fit_table <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(FIT), function(nm) {
  f <- FIT[[nm]]
  data.frame(fit = nm, label = f$label, model = f$feature,
             basis = f$spec$type, knots_x = length(f$spec$knots_x),
             knots_y = length(f$spec$knots_y), coefficients = length(f$coef),
             shoes = length(f$shoes), rows = f$nobs, cases = f$n_cases,
             nAGQ = if (is.null(f$nAGQ)) NA else f$nAGQ,
             conv = f$conv, messages = paste(f$messages, collapse = "; "),
             sigma2 = f$sigma2, loglik = f$loglik,
             seconds = if (is.null(f$seconds)) NA else round(f$seconds))
}))
print(fit_table, row.names = FALSE)
out_csv(fit_table, "fits")
```

## (a) The data

```{r t6_data}
shoe_table <- function(ds) {
  d <- D[[ds]]
  codes <- CODES[[ds]]
  id <- codes$shoe[match(sort(unique(d$shoe)), codes$code)]
  cases <- as.numeric(tapply(d$n_Acc, d$shoe, sum))
  racs <- as.numeric(table(factor(LOC[[ds]]$shoe, levels = id)))
  px <- PC[[ds]]$pixel_count[match(id, PC[[ds]]$shoe)]
  data.frame(dataset = toupper(ds), id = id, racs = racs, cases = cases,
             px = px, density = 1000 * cases / px)
}
ST <- rbind(shoe_table("old"), shoe_table("new"))
ST$dataset <- factor(ST$dataset, levels = c("OLD", "NEW"))
q <- function(v, p) as.numeric(stats::quantile(v, p))
top10 <- function(v) {
  v <- sort(v, decreasing = TRUE)
  sum(v[seq_len(ceiling(length(v) / 10))]) / sum(v)
}
data_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("OLD", "NEW"), function(ds) {
  s <- ST[ST$dataset == ds, ]
  dd <- D[[tolower(ds)]]
  data.frame(dataset = ds, shoes = nrow(s), racs = sum(s$racs),
             rac_pixels = sum(s$cases), controls = sum(dd$n_Acc == 0),
             cc_rows = nrow(dd),
             racs_min = min(s$racs), racs_median = median(s$racs),
             racs_mean = mean(s$racs), racs_p90 = q(s$racs, 0.9),
             racs_max = max(s$racs), top10_share = top10(s$racs),
             px_p5 = q(s$px, 0.05), px_median = median(s$px),
             px_p95 = q(s$px, 0.95), px_mean = mean(s$px),
             density_median = median(s$density),
             density_overall = 1000 * sum(s$cases) / sum(s$px),
             var_log_100_px = var(log(100 / s$px)),
             cor_log_n_log_px = cor(log(s$cases), log(s$px)),
             mean_offset = MEAN_OFFSET[[tolower(ds)]])
}))
print(t(data_summary))
out_csv(data_summary, "data_summary")
# per-shoe tests of the distributions (descriptive: the shoes are not a
# random sample of one population, and 67 NEW shoes reprint OLD ones)
for (v in c("racs", "px", "density")) {
  w <- stats::wilcox.test(ST[[v]][ST$dataset == "OLD"], ST[[v]][ST$dataset == "NEW"])
  cat(sprintf("%s per shoe: OLD median %.4g, NEW median %.4g; Wilcoxon p %.3g\n",
              v, median(ST[[v]][ST$dataset == "OLD"]),
              median(ST[[v]][ST$dataset == "NEW"]), w$p.value))
}
types <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(LOC), function(ds) {
  tt <- table(factor(LOC[[ds]]$type, levels = sort(unique(c(LOC$old$type, LOC$new$type)))))
  data.frame(dataset = toupper(ds), type = as.integer(names(tt)),
             racs = as.numeric(tt), share = as.numeric(tt) / sum(tt))
}))
print(types, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)
out_csv(types, "rac_types")
# RAC type mix per shoe: the share of type 1 and of type 2 among each shoe's RACs
type_mix <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(LOC), function(ds) {
  l <- LOC[[ds]]
  data.frame(dataset = toupper(ds),
             share1 = as.numeric(tapply(l$type == 1, l$shoe, mean)),
             share2 = as.numeric(tapply(l$type == 2, l$shoe, mean)))
}))
for (ds in c("OLD", "NEW")) {
  s <- type_mix[type_mix$dataset == ds, ]
  cat(sprintf("%s: per-shoe share of type 1: median %.2f, p10 %.2f, p90 %.2f; type 2: median %.2f\n",
              ds, median(s$share1), q(s$share1, 0.1), q(s$share1, 0.9), median(s$share2)))
}
# NEW without the reprinted shoes: is the type mix a dataset property?
tn <- LOC$new[!LOC$new$shoe %in% reprints, ]
cat(sprintf("NEW without the %d reprinted or uncertain shoes: type 1 %.3f, type 2 %.3f of %d RACs\n",
            length(reprints), mean(tn$type == 1), mean(tn$type == 2), nrow(tn)))
tr <- LOC$new[LOC$new$shoe %in% reprints, ]
cat(sprintf("NEW reprinted or uncertain shoes only: type 1 %.3f, type 2 %.3f of %d RACs\n",
            mean(tr$type == 1), mean(tr$type == 2), nrow(tr)))
# the same physical soles in both datasets (the T0 pairs judged same_shoe):
# does the type mix follow the dataset or the sole?
vd <- utils::read.csv(file.path(ROOT_PATH, "docs", "qa", "T0", "compare",
                                paste("overlap_verdicts_t0", T6_SUFFIX, ".csv", sep = "")))
vd <- vd[vd$verdict == "same_shoe", ]
pair_types <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(vd)), function(k) {
  o <- LOC$old$type[LOC$old$shoe == vd$old[k]]
  n <- LOC$new$type[LOC$new$shoe == vd$new[k]]
  data.frame(new = vd$new[k], old = vd$old[k], racs_old = length(o), racs_new = length(n),
             type1_old = mean(o == 1), type1_new = mean(n == 1))
}))
pt <- pair_types[pair_types$racs_old >= 5 & pair_types$racs_new >= 5, ]
st <- stats::wilcox.test(pt$type1_new, pt$type1_old, paired = TRUE)
cat(sprintf(paste("same_shoe pairs with >= 5 RACs in both prints: %d; type-1 share OLD print median %.2f,",
                  "NEW print median %.2f; NEW higher in %d of %d pairs; paired Wilcoxon p %.3g\n"),
            nrow(pt), median(pt$type1_old), median(pt$type1_new), sum(pt$type1_new > pt$type1_old),
            nrow(pt), st$p.value))
out_csv(pair_types, "rac_types_reprint_pairs")
# RAC-level evidence (T6 review fixes): on the same pairs, the RACs of the
# OLD and the NEW print of one sole matched by location (t6_match_racs: the
# NEW print moved by up to 0.03 units in each direction, in steps of one
# prototype pixel, mirrored or not; RACs closer than 0.008 units, about 2.4
# pixels, paired one to one). Same RAC, same type?
r_match <- 0.008
shifts <- seq(-0.03, 0.03, by = 1 / px_per_unit)
t_match <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
MATCH <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(pt)), function(k) {
  o <- LOC$old[LOC$old$shoe == pt$old[k], ]
  n <- LOC$new[LOC$new$shoe == pt$new[k], ]
  m <- t6_match_racs(o, n, r_match, shifts)
  mm <- m$matched
  list(racs = data.frame(new = pt$new[k], old = pt$old[k], type_old = o$type[mm$i],
                         type_new = n$type[mm$j], distance = mm$d),
       info = data.frame(new = pt$new[k], old = pt$old[k], racs_old = nrow(o), racs_new = nrow(n),
                         matched = nrow(mm), mirror = m$mirror, dx = m$dx, dy = m$dy,
                         same_type = mean(o$type[mm$i] == n$type[mm$j]),
                         type1_old_matched = mean(o$type[mm$i] == 1),
                         type1_new_matched = mean(n$type[mm$j] == 1),
                         type1_new_unmatched = if (nrow(n) > nrow(mm)) mean(n$type[-mm$j] == 1) else NA_real_))
})
match_racs <- do.call(rbind, lapply(MATCH, function(m) m$racs))
match_info <- do.call(rbind, lapply(MATCH, function(m) m$info))
type_levels <- sort(unique(c(LOC$old$type, LOC$new$type)))
match_tab <- as.data.frame(table(type_old = factor(match_racs$type_old, levels = type_levels),
                                 type_new = factor(match_racs$type_new, levels = type_levels)),
                           responseName = "racs")
match_tab$type_old <- as.integer(as.character(match_tab$type_old))
match_tab$type_new <- as.integer(as.character(match_tab$type_new))
cat(sprintf(paste("matched RACs on the %d same_shoe pairs: %d of %d OLD and %d NEW RACs (median share of an OLD print",
                  "matched %.2f); mirror +1 in %d pairs, -1 in %d; median |dx| %.4f, |dy| %.4f; %.0f s\n"),
            nrow(match_info), nrow(match_racs), sum(match_info$racs_old), sum(match_info$racs_new),
            median(match_info$matched / match_info$racs_old), sum(match_info$mirror == 1),
            sum(match_info$mirror == -1), median(abs(match_info$dx)), median(abs(match_info$dy)),
            proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - t_match))
print(xtabs(racs ~ type_old + type_new, match_tab))
cat(sprintf(paste("matched RACs with the same type on both prints: %.3f; type 2 on OLD -> type 1 on NEW: %d,",
                  "type 1 on OLD -> type 2 on NEW: %d; type-1 share among the matched RACs: OLD print %.3f,",
                  "NEW print %.3f; type-1 share of the NEW RACs without an OLD match %.3f\n"),
            mean(match_racs$type_old == match_racs$type_new),
            sum(match_racs$type_old == 2 & match_racs$type_new == 1),
            sum(match_racs$type_old == 1 & match_racs$type_new == 2),
            mean(match_racs$type_old == 1), mean(match_racs$type_new == 1),
            weighted.mean(match_info$type1_new_unmatched, match_info$racs_new - match_info$matched, na.rm = TRUE)))
out_csv(match_tab, "rac_types_matched")
out_csv(match_info, "rac_types_matched_pairs")
```

```{r t6_data_figure}
ecdf_df <- function(v, ds) {
  v <- sort(v)
  data.frame(dataset = ds, value = v, p = seq_along(v) / length(v))
}
lab_ds <- c(OLD = sprintf("OLD (%d shoes)", n_shoes[["old"]]),
            NEW = sprintf("NEW (%d shoes)", n_shoes[["new"]]))
col_ds <- c(OLD = COL[["old"]], NEW = COL[["new"]])
mk_ecdf <- function(var, xlab, title, log = TRUE) {
  e <- rbind(ecdf_df(ST[[var]][ST$dataset == "OLD"], "OLD"),
             ecdf_df(ST[[var]][ST$dataset == "NEW"], "NEW"))
  e$dataset <- factor(e$dataset, levels = c("OLD", "NEW"))
  med <- aggregate(value ~ dataset, e, median)
  p <- ggplot(e, aes(value, p, colour = dataset)) +
    geom_step(linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_point(data = med, aes(value, 0.5), size = 2.2) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = col_ds, labels = lab_ds) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = "share of shoes at or below", title = title) +
    theme_t6()
  if (log) p <- p + scale_x_log10()
  p
}
p1 <- mk_ecdf("racs", "RACs per shoe (log scale)", "RACs per shoe")
p2 <- mk_ecdf("px", "contact pixels per shoe, S (log scale)", "Contact surface per shoe")
p3 <- mk_ecdf("density", "RAC pixels per 1,000 contact pixels (log scale)",
              "RAC density per shoe")
types$dataset <- factor(types$dataset, levels = c("OLD", "NEW"))
p4 <- ggplot(types, aes(factor(type), share, fill = dataset)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.75) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(share < 0.01, sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * share), sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * share)),
                colour = dataset),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), vjust = -0.4, size = 3,
            show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_ds, labels = lab_ds) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(OLD = INK2, NEW = INK2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(v) paste(100 * v, "%", sep = ""),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(x = "RAC type code in the locations file (codebook not in the repository)",
       y = "share of the dataset's RACs", title = "RAC type") +
  theme_t6()
draw_grid <- function(plots, nrow, ncol, title = NULL) {
  grid::grid.newpage()
  top <- if (is.null(title)) 0 else 0.05
  for (k in seq_along(plots)) {
    r <- (k - 1) %/% ncol
    cc <- (k - 1) %% ncol
    vp <- grid::viewport(x = (cc + 0.5) / ncol, y = (1 - top) * (1 - (r + 0.5) / nrow),
                         width = 1 / ncol, height = (1 - top) / nrow)
    print(plots[[k]], vp = vp)
  }
  if (!is.null(title)) {
    grid::grid.text(title, x = 0.01, y = 1 - top / 2, just = "left",
                    gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold", col = INK))
  }
}
save_fig("data_overview", 12, 8.5, function() {
  draw_grid(list(p1, p2, p3, p4), 2, 2,
            "The two datasets: shoes, contact surface, RAC density and RAC type")
})
```

## (c) The models: sigma^2, fixed effects, equality and all-spatial Wald tests

```{r t6_sigma2}
sig_row <- function(nm, dataset, offset, shoes) {
  f <- FIT[[nm]]
  data.frame(fit = nm, dataset = dataset, offset = offset, shoes = shoes,
             basis = if (grepl("_ob$|norep|groupB", nm)) "OLD step-3 basis" else "own step-3 basis",
             n_shoes = length(f$shoes), sigma2 = f$sigma2, theta = f$theta,
             intercept = unname(f$coef[1]), loglik = f$loglik, nAGQ = f$nAGQ,
             conv = f$conv)
}
sig_rows <- list(
  list("glmm_old", "OLD", "none", "all"),
  list("glmm_new", "NEW", "none", "all"),
  list("glmm_new_ob", "NEW", "none", "all"),
  list("glmm_norep_new", "NEW", "none", "without reprints"),
  list("glmm_groupB_new", "NEW", "none", "group B only"),
  list("off_old", "OLD", "log((px - n)/100)", "all"),
  list("off_new", "NEW", "log((px - n)/100)", "all"),
  list("off_norep_new", "NEW", "log((px - n)/100)", "without reprints"))
sigma2_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(Filter(function(r) have(r[[1]]), sig_rows),
                                    function(r) do.call(sig_row, r)))
# profile-likelihood 95% intervals (approximate: the intercept re-optimized,
# the spatial coefficients held at their estimates; theta = sigma)
sigma2_tab$sigma2_lo <- NA_real_
sigma2_tab$sigma2_hi <- NA_real_
for (k in intersect(names(PROF), sigma2_tab$fit)) {
  sigma2_tab$sigma2_lo[sigma2_tab$fit == k] <- PROF[[k]]$sigma2_lo
  sigma2_tab$sigma2_hi[sigma2_tab$fit == k] <- PROF[[k]]$sigma2_hi
}
# the intercept relation of an offset refit (plan F35, A-044): intercept =
# no-offset intercept + mean over shoes of log(100 / (px - n)), approximately
off_check <- function(off, base, ds) {
  d <- data_of(FIT[[off]], ds)
  o <- tapply(t6_offset_values(d, CODES[[ds]], PC[[ds]]), d$shoe, mean)
  pred <- FIT[[base]]$coef[1] - mean(o)
  data.frame(fit = off, intercept = unname(FIT[[off]]$coef[1]),
             predicted = unname(pred),
             max_spatial_change = max(abs(FIT[[off]]$coef[-1] - FIT[[base]]$coef[-1])))
}
off_pairs <- list(c("off_old", "glmm_old", "old"), c("off_new", "glmm_new", "new"),
                  c("off_norep_new", "glmm_norep_new", "new"))
off_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(Filter(function(p) have(p[1], p[2]), off_pairs),
                                 function(p) off_check(p[1], p[2], p[3])))
print(sigma2_tab, digits = 6, row.names = FALSE)
print(off_tab, digits = 6, row.names = FALSE)
# OLD vs NEW on the log scale, with the SE of log sigma^2 read from the
# profile interval (half its width / 1.96; the profile is close to symmetric
# in log sigma^2), so z = difference / sqrt(se_old^2 + se_new^2)
sig_z <- function(a, b) {
  if (!all(c(a, b) %in% names(PROF))) return(NULL)
  se <- function(k) (log(PROF[[k]]$sigma2_hi) - log(PROF[[k]]$sigma2_lo)) / (2 * 1.96)
  z <- (log(FIT[[b]]$sigma2) - log(FIT[[a]]$sigma2)) / sqrt(se(a)^2 + se(b)^2)
  data.frame(old = a, new = b, sigma2_old = FIT[[a]]$sigma2, sigma2_new = FIT[[b]]$sigma2,
             ratio_new_old = FIT[[b]]$sigma2 / FIT[[a]]$sigma2, z_log = z,
             p_two_sided = 2 * stats::pnorm(-abs(z)))
}
sig_cmp <- do.call(rbind, list(sig_z("glmm_old", "glmm_new"), sig_z("off_old", "off_new"),
                               sig_z("glmm_old", "glmm_norep_new"), sig_z("off_old", "off_norep_new")))
if (!is.null(sig_cmp)) print(sig_cmp, digits = 4, row.names = FALSE)
out_csv(merge(sigma2_tab, off_tab, by = "fit", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE), "sigma2")
if (!is.null(sig_cmp)) out_csv(sig_cmp, "sigma2_tests")
# a model-free check of these z values (T6 review fixes): the moment
# estimator of plan F82 (t6_sigma2_moment) per dataset, its SE from a
# whole-shoe bootstrap (OLD and NEW resampled independently), without and
# with the offset
PSH <- list(old = t6_per_shoe(D$old, CODES$old, PC$old),
            new = t6_per_shoe(D$new, CODES$new, PC$new),
            norep = t6_per_shoe(D$new[!D$new$shoe %in% reprints, ], CODES$new, PC$new))
B_mom <- 4000
set.seed(T6_SEEDS$sigma_moment)
mom_idx <- lapply(PSH, function(s) replicate(B_mom, sample(nrow(s), replace = TRUE)))
mom_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c(FALSE, TRUE), function(off) {
  est <- vapply(PSH, function(s) t6_sigma2_moment(s$n, s$nc, s$px, off), 0)
  bt <- vapply(names(PSH), function(k) {
    s <- PSH[[k]]
    apply(mom_idx[[k]], 2, function(i) t6_sigma2_moment(s$n[i], s$nc[i], s$px[i], off))
  }, numeric(B_mom))
  se <- apply(log(bt), 2, stats::sd)
  do.call(rbind, lapply(c("new", "norep"), function(nw) {
    lr <- log(bt[, nw]) - log(bt[, "old"])
    z <- (log(est[[nw]]) - log(est[["old"]])) / sqrt(se[[nw]]^2 + se[["old"]]^2)
    data.frame(offset = if (off) "log((px - n)/100)" else "none",
               new = if (nw == "new") "NEW (all)" else "NEW without reprints",
               sigma2_old = est[["old"]], sigma2_new = est[[nw]], ratio_new_old = est[[nw]] / est[["old"]],
               ratio_lo = exp(stats::quantile(lr, 0.025, names = FALSE)),
               ratio_hi = exp(stats::quantile(lr, 0.975, names = FALSE)),
               se_log_old = se[["old"]], se_log_new = se[[nw]], z_log = z, p_two_sided = 2 * stats::pnorm(-abs(z)),
               B = B_mom)
  }))
}))
print(mom_tab, digits = 4, row.names = FALSE)
out_csv(mom_tab, "sigma2_moment_bootstrap")
```

```{r t6_fixef}
# the common basis: OLD's own step-3 basis; NEW refitted on it (A-112)
for (nm in intersect(c("glmm_new_ob", "cml_new_ob", "glmm_norep_new", "cml_norep_new",
                       "glmm_groupB_new", "cml_groupB_new"), names(FIT))) {
  base <- if (startsWith(nm, "glmm")) FIT$glmm_old else FIT$cml_old
  stopifnot(identical(base$spec[-1], FIT[[nm]]$spec[-1]),
            identical(names(base$coef), names(FIT[[nm]]$coef)))
}
# the bootstrap SE of a GLMM coefficient where its fit has a bootstrap
boot_of <- c(glmm_old = "old", glmm_new_ob = "new_ob", glmm_norep_new = "norep")
se_boot <- function(nm) {
  k <- boot_of[nm]
  if (is.na(k) || is.null(BOOT[[k]])) return(rep(NA_real_, length(FIT[[nm]]$coef)))
  unname(apply(BOOT[[k]]$draws, 2, stats::sd))
}
fixef_rows <- function(a, b, model, comparison) {
  ka <- FIT[[a]]
  kb <- FIT[[b]]
  se_a <- sqrt(diag(ka$vcov))
  se_b <- sqrt(diag(kb$vcov))
  sb_a <- se_boot(a)
  sb_b <- se_boot(b)
  data.frame(model = model, comparison = comparison, term = names(ka$coef),
             b_old = unname(ka$coef), se_old = unname(se_a),
             b_new = unname(kb$coef), se_new = unname(se_b),
             diff = unname(kb$coef - ka$coef),
             z_diff = unname((kb$coef - ka$coef) / sqrt(se_a^2 + se_b^2)),
             se_old_boot = sb_a, se_new_boot = sb_b,
             z_diff_boot = unname((kb$coef - ka$coef) / sqrt(sb_a^2 + sb_b^2)))
}
fx_pairs <- list(
  list("glmm_old", "glmm_new_ob", "GLMM", "NEW (all) on the OLD basis"),
  list("cml_old", "cml_new_ob", "CML", "NEW (all) on the OLD basis"),
  list("glmm_old", "glmm_norep_new", "GLMM", "NEW without reprints, OLD basis"),
  list("cml_old", "cml_norep_new", "CML", "NEW without reprints, OLD basis"),
  list("glmm_old", "glmm_groupB_new", "GLMM", "NEW group B only, OLD basis"),
  list("cml_old", "cml_groupB_new", "CML", "NEW group B only, OLD basis"))
fixef_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(Filter(function(p) have(p[[1]], p[[2]]), fx_pairs),
                                   function(p) do.call(fixef_rows, p)))
print(fixef_tab[fixef_tab$comparison == "NEW (all) on the OLD basis", ], digits = 4, row.names = FALSE)
out_csv(fixef_tab, "fixef")
for (cmp in unique(fixef_tab$comparison)) {
  for (m in c("GLMM", "CML")) {
    sel <- fixef_tab$comparison == cmp & fixef_tab$model == m & fixef_tab$term != "(Intercept)"
    if (!any(sel)) next
    z <- fixef_tab$z_diff[sel]
    zb <- fixef_tab$z_diff_boot[sel]
    cat(sprintf("%s, %s: |z_diff| > 1.96 for %d of %d spatial coefficients, max |z| %.2f%s\n",
                m, cmp, sum(abs(z) > 1.96), length(z), max(abs(z)),
                if (all(is.na(zb))) "" else sprintf("; bootstrap SEs: %d of %d, max |z| %.2f",
                                                    sum(abs(zb) > 1.96), length(zb), max(abs(zb)))))
  }
}
```

```{r t6_wald}
# equality of the spatial surfaces (all spatial coefficients equal; the
# GLMM intercept is not part of the shape and is dropped), model-based V
# (RX for both GLMMs, A-055) with chi^2 df 24
eq_row <- function(a, b, model, comparison, vcov = "vcov") {
  r <- equality_wald(FIT[[a]]$coef, FIT[[b]]$coef, FIT[[a]][[vcov]], FIT[[b]][[vcov]])
  data.frame(model = model, comparison = comparison,
             variance = if (vcov == "vcov") "model-based (GLMM: RX)" else "model-based (OLD: stored Hessian)",
             W = r$W, df = r$df, p = r$p, reference = r$reference, B = NA_integer_)
}
eq_pairs <- list(
  list("glmm_old", "glmm_new_ob", "GLMM", "OLD vs NEW (all), OLD basis"),
  list("glmm_old", "glmm_norep_new", "GLMM", "OLD vs NEW without reprints, OLD basis"),
  list("glmm_old", "glmm_groupB_new", "GLMM", "OLD vs NEW group B only, OLD basis"),
  list("cml_old", "cml_new_ob", "CML", "OLD vs NEW (all), OLD basis"),
  list("cml_old", "cml_norep_new", "CML", "OLD vs NEW without reprints, OLD basis"),
  list("cml_old", "cml_groupB_new", "CML", "OLD vs NEW group B only, OLD basis"))
eq_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(Filter(function(p) have(p[[1]], p[[2]]), eq_pairs),
                                function(p) do.call(eq_row, p)))
# the shoe-bootstrap version (primary, plan T6 and A-045): paired difference
# draws of the two GLMM bootstraps, W referred to F(24, B - 24)
eq_boot <- function(ka, kb, comparison) {
  if (is.null(BOOT[[ka]]) || is.null(BOOT[[kb]])) return(NULL)
  a <- boot_fit[[ka]]
  b <- boot_fit[[kb]]
  Dd <- t6_boot_pair(BOOT[[ka]], BOOT[[kb]], FIT[[a]], FIT[[b]])
  r <- equality_wald(FIT[[a]]$coef, FIT[[b]]$coef, Dd = Dd)
  data.frame(model = "GLMM", comparison = comparison,
             variance = "shoe bootstrap (paired difference draws)",
             W = r$W, df = r$df, p = r$p, reference = r$reference, B = r$B)
}
eq_tab <- rbind(eq_tab, eq_boot("old", "new_ob", "OLD vs NEW (all), OLD basis"),
                eq_boot("old", "norep", "OLD vs NEW without reprints, OLD basis"))
# indicative cluster-robust version (A-028: survival has no robust variance
# for the exact CML, so the Efron approximation with cluster(shoe), on the
# OLD basis for both datasets)
efron_cluster <- function(d, spec) {
  X <- t6_design(spec, d$new_x, d$y)
  tm <- rep(1, nrow(d))
  m <- survival::coxph(Surv(tm, d$n_Acc) ~ X + strata(d$shoe) + cluster(d$shoe),
                       ties = "efron")
  b <- stats::coef(m)
  names(b) <- sub("^X", "", names(b))
  list(coef = b, V_model = m$naive.var, V_robust = m$var)
}
spec_old <- FIT$cml_old$spec
EF <- list(old = efron_cluster(D$old, spec_old),
           new = efron_cluster(D$new, spec_old),
           norep = efron_cluster(D$new[!D$new$shoe %in% reprints, ], spec_old))
ef_row <- function(b, comparison) {
  rows <- list()
  for (v in c("V_model", "V_robust")) {
    r <- equality_wald(EF$old$coef, EF[[b]]$coef, EF$old[[v]], EF[[b]][[v]])
    rows[[v]] <- data.frame(model = "CML (Efron ties, indicative)", comparison = comparison,
                            variance = if (v == "V_model") "model-based" else "cluster-robust (shoe)",
                            W = r$W, df = r$df, p = r$p, reference = r$reference, B = NA_integer_)
  }
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}
eq_tab <- rbind(eq_tab, ef_row("new", "OLD vs NEW (all), OLD basis"),
                ef_row("norep", "OLD vs NEW without reprints, OLD basis"))
# Every test takes Var(b_old - b_new) = V_old + V_new, i.e. independent
# samples (T6 review fixes). That holds only without the reprints: with
# them (67 NEW shoes are prints of OLD soles, plan F25; 26 of the 89
# reprinted or uncertain shoes are in group B) Cov(b_old, b_new) > 0 is
# ignored, V_old + V_new overstates the variance and the test is
# conservative. The primary test is the GLMM shoe bootstrap without the
# reprints.
eq_tab$samples <- ifelse(grepl("without reprints", eq_tab$comparison),
                         "independent (no NEW reprint of an OLD sole)",
                         "shared soles ignored: conservative")
eq_tab$primary <- eq_tab$model == "GLMM" & grepl("without reprints", eq_tab$comparison) &
  grepl("bootstrap", eq_tab$variance)
stopifnot(sum(eq_tab$primary) <= 1)
ef_se <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(EF), function(k) {
  r <- sqrt(diag(EF[[k]]$V_robust)) / sqrt(diag(EF[[k]]$V_model))
  data.frame(data = k, robust_model_se_median = median(r), min = min(r), max = max(r))
}))
print(ef_se, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)
print(eq_tab[, c("model", "comparison", "variance", "W", "df", "p", "reference", "samples", "primary")],
      digits = 4, row.names = FALSE)
out_csv(eq_tab, "equality_wald")

# (f) the all-spatial Wald test of each dataset (W = b' V^-1 b, df 24)
allsp <- function(nm, variance = "vcov") {
  f <- FIT[[nm]]
  idx <- which(names(f$coef) != "(Intercept)")
  b <- f$coef[idx]
  V <- f[[variance]][idx, idx]
  W <- as.numeric(crossprod(b, solve(V, b)))
  data.frame(fit = nm, label = f$label,
             variance = if (variance == "vcov") "RX (GLMM) / model-based (CML)" else "lme4 default (OLD: stored Hessian)",
             W = W, df = length(b), p = stats::pchisq(W, length(b), lower.tail = FALSE),
             reference = "chi2", B = NA_integer_, cases = f$n_cases, W_per_case = W / f$n_cases)
}
allsp_boot <- function(k) {
  if (is.null(BOOT[[k]])) return(NULL)
  nm <- boot_fit[[k]]
  f <- FIT[[nm]]
  r <- t6_wald_boot(f$coef, t6_boot_draws(BOOT[[k]], f))
  data.frame(fit = nm, label = f$label, variance = "shoe bootstrap", W = r$W, df = r$df, p = r$p,
             reference = r$reference, B = r$B, cases = f$n_cases, W_per_case = r$W / f$n_cases)
}
wald_tab <- do.call(rbind, c(list(allsp("glmm_old", "vcov_default")),
                             lapply(intersect(c("glmm_old", "glmm_new", "glmm_new_ob", "glmm_norep_new",
                                                "glmm_groupB_new", "cml_old", "cml_new", "cml_new_ob",
                                                "cml_norep_new", "cml_groupB_new"), names(FIT)), allsp),
                             lapply(names(BOOT), allsp_boot)))
committed_w <- c(old = read.csv(rac_path(P_old, "wald_test"))$W, new = read.csv(rac_path(P_new, "wald_test"))$W)
stopifnot(abs(wald_tab$W[1] - committed_w[["old"]]) < 1e-6 * committed_w[["old"]],
          abs(wald_tab$W[wald_tab$fit == "glmm_new" & wald_tab$reference == "chi2"] - committed_w[["new"]]) <
            1e-6 * committed_w[["new"]])
print(wald_tab, digits = 5, row.names = FALSE)
out_csv(wald_tab, "wald_all_spatial")
# bootstrap vs model-based SEs of the spatial coefficients (RX vcov)
boot_se_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(BOOT), function(k) {
  f <- FIT[[boot_fit[[k]]]]
  r <- (apply(BOOT[[k]]$draws, 2, stats::sd) / sqrt(diag(f$vcov)))[-1]
  data.frame(bootstrap = k, fit = boot_fit[[k]], B = nrow(BOOT[[k]]$draws),
             failed = length(BOOT[[k]]$failed), se_ratio_median = median(r),
             se_ratio_min = min(r), se_ratio_max = max(r))
}))
if (!is.null(boot_se_tab)) {
  print(boot_se_tab, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)
  out_csv(boot_se_tab, "bootstrap_se_ratio")
}
```

## (d) Maps on the common prototype grid

```{r t6_grid}
G <- t6_grid(P_old)
inside <- G$inside
mask_mat <- G$mask != 0
rows_in <- range(which(rowSums(mask_mat) > 0))
cols_in <- range(which(colSums(mask_mat) > 0))
crop_r <- max(1, rows_in[1] - 6):min(G$nrow, rows_in[2] + 6)
crop_c <- max(1, cols_in[1] - 6):min(G$ncol, cols_in[2] + 6)
# calibrated density (RAC pixels per 1,000 contact pixels) of a fit on the
# grid, with the SE of its log
cal_of <- function(nm) {
  ds <- ds_of(nm)
  t6_calibration(FIT[[nm]], FIT[[nm]]$spec, data_of(FIT[[nm]], ds), CODES[[ds]], PC[[ds]])
}
CAL <- list()
dens_grid <- function(nm) {
  if (is.null(CAL[[nm]])) CAL[[nm]] <<- cal_of(nm)
  r <- t6_density(FIT[[nm]], FIT[[nm]]$spec, G$x[inside], G$y[inside], CAL[[nm]])
  dens <- rep(NA_real_, length(G$x))
  se <- rep(NA_real_, length(G$x))
  dens[inside] <- 1000 * r$density
  se[inside] <- r$se_log
  list(dens = dens, se_log = se)
}
MAPS <- list()
for (nm in names(FIT)) {
  if (!isTRUE(FIT[[nm]]$offset_refit) && !grepl("nagq0_", nm)) MAPS[[nm]] <- dens_grid(nm)
}
cal_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(CAL), function(nm) {
  data.frame(fit = nm, observed_per_1000 = 1000 * CAL[[nm]]$observed_density,
             map_mean_per_1000 = mean(MAPS[[nm]]$dens[inside]),
             map_min = min(MAPS[[nm]]$dens[inside]), map_max = max(MAPS[[nm]]$dens[inside]))
}))
print(cal_tab, digits = 4, row.names = FALSE)
# data support of each dataset around each grid pixel: the number of RAC
# pixels (cases) within a box of 21 x 21 prototype pixels (0.07 units)
# counts (or weights) of case-control rows on the prototype grid, and their
# sums over a box of 21 x 21 prototype pixels (0.07 units) around each pixel
grid_hist <- function(new_x, y, w = rep(1, length(new_x))) {
  col <- round(new_x * px_per_unit + G$ncol / 2)
  row <- round(-y * px_per_unit + G$nrow / 2)
  ok <- col >= 1 & col <= G$ncol & row >= 1 & row <= G$nrow
  h <- matrix(0, G$nrow, G$ncol)
  agg <- tapply(w[ok], (col[ok] - 1) * G$nrow + row[ok], sum)
  h[as.integer(names(agg))] <- agg
  h
}
box21 <- function(h, r = 10) {
  # integral image: ii[i + 1, j + 1] = sum(h[1:i, 1:j])
  ii <- rbind(0, cbind(0, t(apply(apply(h, 2, cumsum), 1, cumsum))))
  r0 <- pmax(1, seq_len(G$nrow) - r)
  r1 <- pmin(G$nrow, seq_len(G$nrow) + r)
  c0 <- pmax(1, seq_len(G$ncol) - r)
  c1 <- pmin(G$ncol, seq_len(G$ncol) + r)
  ii[r1 + 1, c1 + 1] - ii[r0, c1 + 1] - ii[r1 + 1, c0] + ii[r0, c0]
}
support <- function(d) {
  cc <- d[d$n_Acc == 1, ]
  box21(grid_hist(cc$new_x, cc$y))
}
# the empirical (model-free) RAC density per 1,000 contact pixels in the box:
# RAC pixels / the contact pixels the controls stand for (each control of
# shoe i stands for (px_i - n_i) / 100 contact pixels, as in t6_calibration)
emp_density <- function(d, ds) {
  s <- t6_shoe_px(d, CODES[[ds]], PC[[ds]])
  n_ctrl <- stats::ave(1 - d$n_Acc, d$shoe, FUN = sum)
  w <- (s$px - s$n) / n_ctrl
  ca <- d$n_Acc == 1
  num <- box21(grid_hist(d$new_x[ca], d$y[ca]))
  den <- box21(grid_hist(d$new_x[!ca], d$y[!ca], w[!ca]))
  out <- 1000 * num / den
  out[!mask_mat | den <= 0] <- NA
  list(dens = out, cases = num)
}
SUP <- list(old = support(D$old), new = support(D$new))
sparse_min <- 10
sparse <- (SUP$old < sparse_min | SUP$new < sparse_min) & mask_mat
cat(sprintf("mask pixels with fewer than %d RAC pixels of either dataset within the 21 x 21 box: %d of %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            sparse_min, sum(sparse), sum(mask_mat), 100 * mean(sparse[mask_mat])))
EMP <- list(old = emp_density(D$old, "old"), new = emp_density(D$new, "new"),
            norep = emp_density(D$new[!D$new$shoe %in% reprints, ], "new"))
for (k in names(EMP)) {
  v <- EMP[[k]]$dens[mask_mat & !sparse]
  cat(sprintf("empirical density %s (21 x 21 box, supported pixels): median %.3f, p5 %.3f, p95 %.3f per 1,000 contact px\n",
              k, median(v, na.rm = TRUE), q(v[!is.na(v)], 0.05), q(v[!is.na(v)], 0.95)))
}
```

```{r t6_map_helpers}
as_mat <- function(v) t6_as_matrix(v, G)
# a figure's title and note in the outer top margin: the note is wrapped to
# the width of the open device (measured with strwidth), and header_oma()
# makes the margin as high as the wrapped note needs
wrap_note <- function(note, cex = 0.72) {
  room <- 0.985 * par("din")[1]
  lines <- character(0)
  cur <- ""
  for (w in strsplit(note, " ", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]) {
    cand <- if (nzchar(cur)) paste(cur, w) else w
    # strwidth multiplies cex by par("cex") (lowered by layout()); mtext's
    # cex is absolute, so measure at cex / par("cex")
    if (nzchar(cur) && strwidth(cand, units = "inches", cex = cex / par("cex")) > room) {
      lines <- c(lines, cur)
      cur <- w
    } else {
      cur <- cand
    }
  }
  c(lines, cur)
}
header_oma <- function(note) c(0, 0, 2.3 + 1.1 * length(wrap_note(note)), 0)
fig_header <- function(title, note) {
  nl <- wrap_note(note)
  n <- length(nl)
  # adj = 0 with at: every line starts at the same left edge (with adj alone,
  # mtext places the point at that fraction of the string's own width there)
  mtext(title, outer = TRUE, side = 3, line = 1.1 * n + 0.6, adj = 0, at = 0.008, font = 2, cex = 1.05,
        col = INK)
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    mtext(nl[i], outer = TRUE, side = 3, line = 1.1 * (n - i) + 0.3, adj = 0, at = 0.008, cex = 0.72,
          col = INK2)
  }
}
xs_c <- G$xs[crop_c]
ys_r <- G$ys[crop_r]
draw_map <- function(mat, zlim, col, title, sub = NULL, z_contour = NULL,
                     cuts = FALSE, shade = NULL, axes = FALSE, areas = NULL,
                     pinned = NULL) {
  m <- mat[crop_r, crop_c]
  m[!is.na(m)] <- pmin(pmax(m[!is.na(m)], zlim[1]), zlim[2])
  par(mar = c(1.2, if (axes) 3.2 else 0.6, 2.6, 0.6))
  image(x = xs_c, y = rev(ys_r), z = t(m[nrow(m):1, ]), col = col, zlim = zlim,
        useRaster = TRUE, asp = 1, axes = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = "")
  if (!is.null(shade)) {
    s <- shade[crop_r, crop_c]
    s[!s] <- NA
    image(x = xs_c, y = rev(ys_r), z = t(s[nrow(s):1, ]), col = grDevices::adjustcolor("#898781", 0.55),
          add = TRUE, useRaster = TRUE)
  }
  mk <- mask_mat[crop_r, crop_c] * 1
  contour(x = xs_c, y = rev(ys_r), z = t(mk[nrow(mk):1, ]), levels = 0.5,
          drawlabels = FALSE, add = TRUE, col = INK2, lwd = 0.8)
  if (!is.null(pinned)) {
    # the band next to the K8-pinned edges (dotted): not data there
    pz <- (pinned & mask_mat)[crop_r, crop_c] * 1
    contour(x = xs_c, y = rev(ys_r), z = t(pz[nrow(pz):1, ]), levels = 0.5,
            drawlabels = FALSE, add = TRUE, col = INK, lwd = 0.8, lty = 3)
  }
  if (!is.null(z_contour)) {
    zz <- z_contour[crop_r, crop_c]
    zz[is.na(zz)] <- 0
    contour(x = xs_c, y = rev(ys_r), z = t(zz[nrow(zz):1, ]), levels = c(-1.96, 1.96),
            drawlabels = FALSE, add = TRUE, col = INK, lwd = 0.9, lty = 1)
  }
  if (cuts) {
    for (r in cut_rows) {
      yy <- G$ys[r]
      xr <- range(G$xs[mask_mat[r, ]])
      segments(xr[1], yy, xr[2], yy, col = INK, lty = 3, lwd = 0.8)
      text(xr[2] + 0.01, yy, r, cex = 0.6, col = INK2, adj = 0)
    }
  }
  if (!is.null(areas)) {
    am <- areas$mat
    for (k in sort(unique(am[!is.na(am)]))) {
      z <- (am == k) * 1
      z[is.na(z)] <- 0
      z <- z[crop_r, crop_c]
      contour(x = xs_c, y = rev(ys_r), z = t(z[nrow(z):1, ]), levels = 0.5,
              drawlabels = FALSE, add = TRUE, col = INK, lwd = 0.7)
    }
    text(areas$cx, areas$cy, areas$k, cex = 0.75, font = 2, col = INK)
  }
  if (axes) {
    axis(2, at = seq(-0.5, 0.5, by = 0.25), las = 1, cex.axis = 0.7, col = INK2, col.axis = INK2)
    mtext("y (toe up)", side = 2, line = 2.2, cex = 0.6, col = INK2)
  }
  title(main = title, cex.main = 0.95, font.main = 2, col.main = INK, line = 1.2)
  if (!is.null(sub)) mtext(sub, side = 3, line = 0.2, cex = 0.62, col = INK2)
}
draw_bar <- function(zlim, col, label, at = NULL, labels = TRUE) {
  par(mar = c(2.6, 2, 0.6, 2))
  z <- seq(zlim[1], zlim[2], length.out = length(col))
  image(x = z, y = 1, z = matrix(z, ncol = 1), col = col, axes = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = "",
        useRaster = TRUE)
  if (is.null(at)) at <- pretty(zlim, 6)
  at <- at[at >= zlim[1] & at <= zlim[2]]
  axis(1, at = at, labels = labels, cex.axis = 0.75, col = INK2, col.axis = INK, mgp = c(2, 0.4, 0),
       tcl = -0.25)
  mtext(label, side = 1, line = 1.6, cex = 0.62, col = INK)
  box(col = GRID_COL)
}
ratio_at <- log2(c(0.25, 0.35, 0.5, 0.71, 1, 1.41, 2, 2.83, 4))
ratio_lab <- c("0.25", "0.35", "0.5", "0.71", "1", "1.41", "2", "2.83", "4")
four_panel <- function(a, b, model_lab, stem, note, se_a = NULL, se_b = NULL,
                       z_lab = "ratio; black line: pointwise |z| = 1.96", pinned = NULL) {
  da <- MAPS[[a]]
  db <- MAPS[[b]]
  if (!is.null(se_a)) da$se_log <- se_a
  if (!is.null(se_b)) db$se_log <- se_b
  zl <- range(c(da$dens, db$dens), na.rm = TRUE)
  diff <- db$dens - da$dens
  dl <- max(abs(diff), na.rm = TRUE) * c(-1, 1)
  lr <- log2(db$dens / da$dens)
  rl <- max(abs(lr), na.rm = TRUE)
  rl <- c(-1, 1) * max(rl, 0.6)
  z <- (log(db$dens) - log(da$dens)) / sqrt(da$se_log^2 + db$se_log^2)
  save_fig(stem, 13, 7.2, function() {
    layout(matrix(c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 5, 6, 7), 2, byrow = TRUE), heights = c(1, 0.13))
    par(oma = header_oma(note))
    draw_map(as_mat(da$dens), zl, SEQ, sprintf("OLD (%d shoes)", length(FIT[[a]]$shoes)),
             FIT[[a]]$label, cuts = TRUE, axes = TRUE)
    draw_map(as_mat(db$dens), zl, SEQ, sprintf("NEW (%d shoes)", length(FIT[[b]]$shoes)),
             FIT[[b]]$label, cuts = TRUE)
    draw_map(as_mat(diff), dl, DIV, "NEW - OLD", "difference of the densities")
    draw_map(as_mat(lr), rl, DIV, "NEW / OLD", z_lab, z_contour = as_mat(z), pinned = pinned)
    draw_bar(zl, SEQ, "RAC pixels per 1,000 contact pixels (both maps on this scale, lowest to highest value)")
    draw_bar(dl, DIV, "NEW - OLD, per 1,000 contact pixels")
    draw_bar(rl, DIV, "NEW / OLD (log scale): red = NEW higher, blue = OLD higher",
             at = ratio_at, labels = ratio_lab[ratio_at >= rl[1] & ratio_at <= rl[2]])
    fig_header(sprintf("%s: RAC density on the prototype, OLD vs NEW", model_lab), note)
  })
  data.frame(stem = stem, old = a, new = b,
             old_mean = mean(da$dens, na.rm = TRUE), new_mean = mean(db$dens, na.rm = TRUE),
             ratio_p5 = q(2^lr[inside], 0.05), ratio_median = median(2^lr[inside]),
             ratio_p95 = q(2^lr[inside], 0.95), ratio_min = min(2^lr[inside]),
             ratio_max = max(2^lr[inside]),
             share_z_above = mean(z[inside] > 1.96), share_z_below = mean(z[inside] < -1.96),
             share_ratio_outside_0.8_1.25 = mean(2^lr[inside] < 0.8 | 2^lr[inside] > 1.25))
}
```

```{r t6_maps}
                  "Dotted rows: the CI cuts 110, 190, 250. x: new_x, the standardized x of the prototype.",
```

```{r t6_maps_boot}
# the common-basis GLMM maps with shoe-bootstrap SEs of the log density (the
# model-based SEs assume the RACs of a shoe independent given its random
# effect, known issue K9). Three kinds per draw (t6_logdens_boot; T6 review
# fixes): "resampled" recalibrates each draw on its own resampled shoes, so
# its SD includes the sampling error of the dataset's overall RAC density
# (for statements about absolute densities, the level included); "fixed"
# holds the dataset's rows and RAC total fixed and "shape" divides each draw
# by its own observed density: both are SDs of the shape, the density
# relative to the dataset's average (for statements about shape). A fourth,
# "proto", normalises each draw by its own mean over the prototype (a common
# reference for both datasets; a sensitivity of the shape normalisation).
pin_width <- 0.03 # units (about 9 prototype pixels) next to the K8-pinned edges
BSD <- list()
for (k in names(BOOT)) {
  nm <- boot_fit[[k]]
  f <- FIT[[nm]]
  ds <- ds_of(nm)
  rows <- t6_cal_rows(f, D[[ds]], CODES[[ds]], PC[[ds]])
  dr <- t6_boot_draws(BOOT[[k]], f)
  r <- t6_logdens_boot(f, rows, dr, G$x[inside], G$y[inside], ids = t6_boot_ids(BOOT[[k]]),
                       kinds = c("fixed", "resampled", "shape"))
  Xp <- cbind(1, t6_design(f$spec, G$x[inside], G$y[inside]))
  s1 <- s2 <- numeric(nrow(Xp))
  for (st in seq(1L, nrow(dr), by = 100L)) {
    kk <- st:min(nrow(dr), st + 99L)
    lp <- Xp %*% t(dr[kk, , drop = FALSE])
    ld <- sweep(lp, 2, log(colMeans(exp(lp))))
    s1 <- s1 + rowSums(ld)
    s2 <- s2 + rowSums(ld^2)
  }
  r$proto <- list(sd = sqrt(pmax(s2 / nrow(dr) - (s1 / nrow(dr))^2, 0) * nrow(dr) / (nrow(dr) - 1)))
  BSD[[nm]] <- lapply(r, function(z) {
    se <- rep(NA_real_, length(G$x))
    se[inside] <- z$sd
    se
  })
}
boot_map_se <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(BSD), function(nm) {
  b <- lapply(BSD[[nm]], function(v) v[inside])
  m <- MAPS[[nm]]$se_log[inside]
  data.frame(fit = nm, sd_log_model_median = median(m), sd_log_boot_fixedN_median = median(b$fixed),
             sd_log_boot_resampled_median = median(b$resampled), sd_log_boot_shape_median = median(b$shape),
             fixedN_over_model_median = median(b$fixed / m), fixedN_over_model_p5 = q(b$fixed / m, 0.05),
             fixedN_over_model_p95 = q(b$fixed / m, 0.95), fixedN_over_model_max = max(b$fixed / m),
             resampled_over_model_median = median(b$resampled / m),
             resampled_over_fixedN_median = median(b$resampled / b$fixed),
             resampled_over_fixedN_p5 = q(b$resampled / b$fixed, 0.05),
             resampled_over_fixedN_p95 = q(b$resampled / b$fixed, 0.95),
             shape_over_fixedN_median = median(b$shape / b$fixed),
             shape_over_fixedN_max_abs_dev = max(abs(b$shape / b$fixed - 1)),
             proto_over_fixedN_median = median(b$proto / b$fixed))
}))
if (!is.null(boot_map_se)) print(boot_map_se, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)
PIN <- as_mat(t6_pinned_band(list(FIT$glmm_old$spec), G$x, G$y, width = pin_width))
note_boot <- paste("NEW refitted on OLD's step-3 knots (the common basis of the coefficient table). Both maps calibrated",
                   "as in the main maps. Black line: pointwise |z| = 1.96 with shoe-bootstrap SEs: whole shoes resampled,",
                   "so RACs of one shoe stay together, and each draw recalibrated on its own resampled shoes, so the SEs",
                   "include the sampling error of each dataset's overall RAC density; not adjusted for multiplicity.",
                   sprintf("Dotted: within %.2f units of the K8-pinned edges, where the surfaces are pinned (not data).", pin_width))
boot_maps <- list(c("glmm_old", "glmm_new_ob", "NEW (all shoes)", "intensity_maps_glmm_commonbasis_boot"),
                  c("glmm_old", "glmm_norep_new", "NEW without the reprinted shoes",
                    "intensity_maps_glmm_commonbasis_norep_boot"))
for (bm in boot_maps) {
  if (!all(bm[1:2] %in% names(BSD))) next
  map_tab <- rbind(map_tab, four_panel(bm[1], bm[2], sprintf("Random effects on the common basis, %s", bm[3]),
                                       bm[4], note_boot, se_a = BSD[[bm[1]]]$resampled, se_b = BSD[[bm[2]]]$resampled,
                                       z_lab = "ratio; black line: |z| = 1.96 (shoe bootstrap, level included)",
                                       pinned = PIN))
}
print(map_tab, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)
if (!is.null(boot_map_se)) out_csv(boot_map_se, "bootstrap_map_se")
# how much of the prototype differs, by quantity and variance, on the whole
# prototype and away from the K8-pinned edges (T6 review fixes)
band_in <- t6_pinned_band(list(FIT$glmm_old$spec), G$x[inside], G$y[inside], width = pin_width)
share_rows <- function(a, b, comparison) {
  la <- log(MAPS[[a]]$dens[inside])
  lb <- log(MAPS[[b]]$dens[inside])
  lvl <- log(CAL[[b]]$observed_density / CAL[[a]]$observed_density)
  sd2 <- function(kind) BSD[[a]][[kind]][inside]^2 + BSD[[b]][[kind]][inside]^2
  v <- list(
    list("absolute (level and shape)", "shoe bootstrap, each draw recalibrated on its resampled shoes",
         lb - la, sd2("resampled")),
    list("absolute (level and shape)", "shoe bootstrap, RAC total fixed (superseded: omits the level's sampling error)",
         lb - la, sd2("fixed")),
    list("absolute (level and shape)", "model-based, RAC total fixed (as the main figures)",
         lb - la, MAPS[[a]]$se_log[inside]^2 + MAPS[[b]]$se_log[inside]^2),
    list("shape: each map / its observed density", "shoe bootstrap, normalisation resampled", lb - la - lvl, sd2("shape")),
    list("shape: each map / its mean over the prototype", "shoe bootstrap",
         (lb - log(mean(exp(lb)))) - (la - log(mean(exp(la)))), sd2("proto")))
  do.call(rbind, lapply(v, function(e) {
    z <- e[[3]] / sqrt(e[[4]])
    data.frame(comparison = comparison, quantity = e[[1]], variance = e[[2]],
               median_ratio = median(exp(e[[3]])), share_higher = mean(z > 1.96), share_lower = mean(z < -1.96),
               share_higher_off_band = mean(z[!band_in] > 1.96), share_lower_off_band = mean(z[!band_in] < -1.96),
               higher_in_band = sum(z > 1.96 & band_in) / max(1, sum(z > 1.96)),
               band_share = mean(band_in), band_width = pin_width)
  }))
}
share_tab <- rbind(share_rows("glmm_old", "glmm_new_ob", "NEW (all) vs OLD, common basis"),
                   share_rows("glmm_old", "glmm_norep_new", "NEW without reprints vs OLD, common basis"))
print(share_tab[, -ncol(share_tab)], digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)
out_csv(share_tab, "map_shares")
# the shape comparison as a figure: each map divided by its dataset's observed
# RAC density (1 = the dataset's average), GLMM with shape |z| contours and the
# same ratio from the data
shape_note <- paste("Each density divided by its own dataset's observed RAC density (RAC pixels / contact pixels), so the",
                    "ratio compares shapes, not levels. GLMM: NEW on OLD's step-3 knots; black line: pointwise |z| = 1.96",
                    "(shoe bootstrap, not adjusted for multiplicity); dotted: the K8-pinned band. Data: 21 x 21-pixel box",
                    "as in the empirical figure; grey: fewer than 10 RAC pixels of OLD or NEW in the box.")
shape_pairs <- list(c("glmm_new_ob", "new", "NEW (all)"), c("glmm_norep_new", "norep", "NEW without reprints"))
SHP <- lapply(shape_pairs, function(sp) {
  a <- "glmm_old"
  b <- sp[1]
  lvl <- log2(CAL[[b]]$observed_density / CAL[[a]]$observed_density)
  lr <- log2(MAPS[[b]]$dens / MAPS[[a]]$dens) - lvl
  z <- (lr * log(2)) / sqrt(BSD[[a]]$shape^2 + BSD[[b]]$shape^2)
  le <- log2(EMP[[sp[2]]]$dens / EMP$old$dens) - lvl
  le[sparse | !mask_mat] <- NA
  list(lr = lr, z = z, le = le, lab = sp[3], lvl = lvl)
})
rl_s <- c(-1, 1) * min(1, max(sapply(SHP, function(s) max(abs(c(s$lr, s$le)), na.rm = TRUE))))
save_fig("ratio_maps_commonbasis_shape_boot", 15, 7.4, function() {
  layout(matrix(c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 5, 5, 5), 2, byrow = TRUE), heights = c(1, 0.13))
  par(oma = header_oma(shape_note))
  for (k in seq_along(SHP)) {
    s <- SHP[[k]]
    draw_map(as_mat(s$lr), rl_s, DIV, sprintf("GLMM: %s / OLD, shape", s$lab),
             sprintf("levels divided out (NEW / OLD %.3f)", 2^s$lvl), z_contour = as_mat(s$z),
             pinned = PIN, shade = sparse, axes = k == 1)
  }
  for (k in seq_along(SHP)) {
    s <- SHP[[k]]
    draw_map(s$le, rl_s, DIV, sprintf("data: %s / OLD, shape", s$lab), "empirical densities, levels divided out",
             shade = sparse)
  }
  draw_bar(rl_s, DIV, "NEW / OLD of the relative densities (log scale): red = NEW relatively higher; beyond 0.5-2 at the end colours",
           at = ratio_at, labels = ratio_lab[ratio_at >= rl_s[1] - 1e-9 & ratio_at <= rl_s[2] + 1e-9])
  fig_header("Shape only: OLD vs NEW with each dataset's overall RAC density divided out", shape_note)
})
```

```{r t6_maps_empirical}
# the data behind the maps: the empirical RAC density in a 21 x 21-pixel box
# (no model, no basis), OLD and NEW on one scale, their ratio, and the GLMM
# ratio of the main maps beside it; grey where either dataset has fewer than
# 10 RAC pixels in the box
emp_fig <- function(new_key, model_new, stem, lab_new) {
  eo <- EMP$old$dens
  en <- EMP[[new_key]]$dens
  sup <- mask_mat & !sparse
  zl <- q(stats::na.omit(c(eo[sup], en[sup])), c(0.005, 0.995))
  lr_e <- log2(en / eo)
  lr_e[!sup] <- NA
  lr_m <- as_mat(log2(MAPS[[model_new]]$dens / MAPS$glmm_old$dens))
  rl <- c(-1, 1) * min(2, max(abs(c(lr_e, lr_m[sup])), na.rm = TRUE))
  emp_note <- paste("Each control stands for (contact pixels - RAC pixels) / 100 of its shoe's contact surface.",
                    "Box sums smooth the data over 0.07 units; the GLMM maps are smoother still and bound by their",
                    "spline basis. Both empirical maps on one scale, from the lowest to the highest value of either.")
  save_fig(stem, 13, 7.2, function() {
    layout(matrix(c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 5, 6, 6), 2, byrow = TRUE), heights = c(1, 0.13))
    par(oma = header_oma(emp_note))
    draw_map(eo, zl, SEQ, sprintf("OLD, empirical (%d shoes)", n_shoes[["old"]]),
             "RAC pixels / contact pixels in the box", axes = TRUE, shade = sparse)
    draw_map(en, zl, SEQ, sprintf("%s, empirical", lab_new), "RAC pixels / contact pixels in the box",
             shade = sparse)
    draw_map(lr_e, rl, DIV, "NEW / OLD, empirical", "grey: fewer than 10 RAC pixels in the box", shade = sparse)
    draw_map(lr_m, rl, DIV, "NEW / OLD, GLMM maps", sprintf("%s vs %s", FIT$glmm_old$label, FIT[[model_new]]$label),
             shade = sparse)
    draw_bar(zl, SEQ, "RAC pixels per 1,000 contact pixels in a box of 21 x 21 prototype pixels (0.07 x 0.07 units); 0.5% clipped at each end")
    draw_bar(rl, DIV, "NEW / OLD (log scale): red = NEW higher, blue = OLD higher", at = ratio_at,
             labels = ratio_lab[ratio_at >= rl[1] & ratio_at <= rl[2]])
    fig_header("The data behind the maps: empirical RAC density on the standardized shoe, without a model",
               emp_note)
  })
  ok <- sup & !is.na(lr_e)
  data.frame(new = new_key, model = model_new, supported_pixels = sum(ok),
             emp_ratio_median = median(2^lr_e[ok]), emp_ratio_p5 = q(2^lr_e[ok], 0.05),
             emp_ratio_p95 = q(2^lr_e[ok], 0.95), model_ratio_median = median(2^lr_m[ok]),
             cor_log_ratios = stats::cor(lr_e[ok], lr_m[ok]))
}
emp_tab <- emp_fig("new", "glmm_new", "empirical_density", sprintf("NEW (%d shoes)", n_shoes[["new"]]))
if (have("glmm_norep_new")) {
  emp_tab <- rbind(emp_tab, emp_fig("norep", "glmm_norep_new", "empirical_density_norep",
                                    sprintf("NEW without reprints (%d shoes)", length(FIT$glmm_norep_new$shoes))))
}
print(emp_tab, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)
out_csv(emp_tab, "empirical_density")
```

```{r t6_regions}
# Model-free check of the regional differences (T6 review fixes): the RAC
# density (RAC pixels / the contact pixels the rows stand for, as in
# t6_calibration) in regions of the standardized shoe, NEW / OLD, with a
# whole-shoe bootstrap (each dataset resampled by shoe, independently; B
# draws, seed T6_SEEDS$regions): absolute, and relative to each dataset's
# overall density (shape only). Beside it the ratio the GLMM maps on the
# common basis imply for the same region (its model-expected RAC pixels over
# its contact pixels, with each dataset's own contact pixels). rel = new_x /
# distance_shape is the position across the prototype's half-width (-1 the
# left edge, 1 the right edge).
REG <- list(
  forefoot_centre = list(lab = "forefoot centre (-0.09 < new_x < -0.01, 0.22 < y < 0.38)",
                         f = function(d) d$new_x > -0.09 & d$new_x < -0.01 & d$y > 0.22 & d$y < 0.38),
  forefoot_right = list(lab = "forefoot right (new_x > 0.12, y > 0.15)",
                        f = function(d) d$new_x > 0.12 & d$y > 0.15),
  forefoot_left = list(lab = "forefoot left (new_x < -0.13, y > 0.15)",
                       f = function(d) d$new_x < -0.13 & d$y > 0.15),
  rim_right_15 = list(lab = "forefoot right rim, outer 15% (rel > 0.85, 0.15 < y < 0.42)",
                      f = function(d) d$y > 0.15 & d$y < 0.42 & d$rel > 0.85),
  rim_left_15 = list(lab = "forefoot left rim, outer 15% (rel < -0.85, 0.15 < y < 0.42)",
                     f = function(d) d$y > 0.15 & d$y < 0.42 & d$rel < -0.85),
  rim_right_25 = list(lab = "forefoot right rim, outer 25% (rel > 0.75, 0.15 < y < 0.42)",
                      f = function(d) d$y > 0.15 & d$y < 0.42 & d$rel > 0.75),
  rim_left_25 = list(lab = "forefoot left rim, outer 25% (rel < -0.75, 0.15 < y < 0.42)",
                     f = function(d) d$y > 0.15 & d$y < 0.42 & d$rel < -0.75),
  toe_tip = list(lab = "toe tip (y >= 0.42)", f = function(d) d$y >= 0.42),
  toe_right = list(lab = "right toe (y >= 0.38, new_x > 0)", f = function(d) d$y >= 0.38 & d$new_x > 0),
  midfoot_top_band = list(lab = "midfoot-top band (-0.05 < y < 0.05)", f = function(d) d$y > -0.05 & d$y < 0.05),
  midfoot_right_edge = list(lab = "midfoot right edge (rel > 0.75, -0.12 < y < 0.15)",
                            f = function(d) d$y > -0.12 & d$y < 0.15 & d$rel > 0.75),
  heel_front_band = list(lab = "heel-front band (-0.18 < y < -0.12)", f = function(d) d$y > -0.18 & d$y < -0.12),
  heel_bottom = list(lab = "heel bottom (y < -0.35)", f = function(d) d$y < -0.35),
  heel_bottom_inner = list(lab = "heel bottom, inner (-0.46 < y < -0.35)", f = function(d) d$y < -0.35 & d$y > -0.46),
  heel_bottom_edge = list(lab = "heel bottom edge (y <= -0.46)", f = function(d) d$y <= -0.46))
REG_DATA <- list(old = D$old, new = D$new, norep = D$new[!D$new$shoe %in% reprints, ])
REG_DATA <- lapply(REG_DATA, function(d) {
  d$rel <- d$new_x / d$distance_shape
  stopifnot(!anyNA(d$rel), all(abs(d$rel) <= 1 + 1e-9))
  d
})
reg_ds <- c(old = "old", new = "new", norep = "new")
REG_TAB <- lapply(names(REG_DATA), function(k) {
  t6_shoe_regions(REG_DATA[[k]], CODES[[reg_ds[[k]]]], PC[[reg_ds[[k]]]], lapply(REG, function(r) r$f))
})
names(REG_TAB) <- names(REG_DATA)
B_reg <- 2000
set.seed(T6_SEEDS$regions)
REG_CNT <- lapply(REG_TAB, function(tab) {
  idx <- replicate(B_reg, sample(nrow(tab), replace = TRUE))
  t(apply(idx, 2, tabulate, nbins = nrow(tab)))
})
rn <- c("all", names(REG))
REG_EST <- lapply(REG_TAB, function(tab) t6_region_density(tab, rn))
REG_BOOT <- lapply(names(REG_TAB), function(k) t6_region_density(REG_TAB[[k]], rn, REG_CNT[[k]]))
names(REG_BOOT) <- names(REG_TAB)
# the ratio the GLMM maps imply: model-expected RAC pixels per row
# (w exp(eta + log c), the calibration of the map) summed over the region
reg_fit <- c(old = "glmm_old", new = "glmm_new_ob", norep = "glmm_norep_new")
REG_MODEL <- lapply(names(reg_fit), function(k) {
  nm <- reg_fit[[k]]
  f <- FIT[[nm]]
  d <- REG_DATA[[k]][REG_DATA[[k]]$shoe %in% f$shoes, ]
  rows <- t6_cal_rows(f, d, CODES[[reg_ds[[k]]]], PC[[reg_ds[[k]]]])
  pred <- rows$w * exp(as.vector(rows$X1 %*% f$coef) + CAL[[nm]]$log_c)
  stopifnot(abs(sum(pred) - rows$N) < 1e-6 * rows$N)
  vapply(rn, function(r) {
    k_r <- if (r == "all") rep(TRUE, nrow(d)) else REG[[r]]$f(d)
    sum(pred[k_r]) / sum(rows$w[k_r])
  }, 0)
})
names(REG_MODEL) <- names(reg_fit)
qq <- function(v, p) as.numeric(stats::quantile(v, p, na.rm = TRUE))
reg_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("new", "norep"), function(nw) {
  ro <- REG_BOOT$old
  rw <- REG_BOOT[[nw]]
  do.call(rbind, lapply(rn, function(r) {
    ratio_b <- rw[, r] / ro[, r]
    shape_b <- (rw[, r] / rw[, "all"]) / (ro[, r] / ro[, "all"])
    est <- REG_EST[[nw]][, r] / REG_EST$old[, r]
    lvl <- REG_EST[[nw]][, "all"] / REG_EST$old[, "all"]
    mod <- REG_MODEL[[nw]][[r]] / REG_MODEL$old[[r]]
    data.frame(comparison = if (nw == "new") "NEW (all) / OLD" else "NEW without reprints / OLD",
               region = r, definition = if (r == "all") "the whole standardized shoe" else REG[[r]]$lab,
               cases_old = sum(REG_TAB$old[[paste(r, "_cases", sep = "")]]),
               cases_new = sum(REG_TAB[[nw]][[paste(r, "_cases", sep = "")]]),
               density_old = 1000 * REG_EST$old[, r], density_new = 1000 * REG_EST[[nw]][, r],
               ratio = est, ratio_lo = qq(ratio_b, 0.025), ratio_hi = qq(ratio_b, 0.975),
               shape_ratio = est / lvl, shape_lo = qq(shape_b, 0.025), shape_hi = qq(shape_b, 0.975),
               glmm_ratio = mod, glmm_shape_ratio = mod / (REG_MODEL[[nw]][["all"]] / REG_MODEL$old[["all"]]),
               B = B_reg, failed_draws = sum(!is.finite(ratio_b)))
  }))
}))
stopifnot(all(reg_tab$failed_draws == 0))
print(reg_tab[, c("comparison", "region", "cases_old", "cases_new", "ratio", "ratio_lo", "ratio_hi",
                  "shape_ratio", "shape_lo", "shape_hi", "glmm_ratio", "glmm_shape_ratio")], digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)
out_csv(reg_tab, "empirical_regions")
# the level alone: the shoe-bootstrap SD of the log observed RAC density of
# each dataset (its overall density; the part the fixed-N bands left out)
lvl_sd <- vapply(REG_BOOT, function(b) stats::sd(log(b[, "all"])), 0)
cat(sprintf("shoe-bootstrap SD of the log overall RAC density: OLD %.4f, NEW %.4f, NEW without reprints %.4f\n",
            lvl_sd[["old"]], lvl_sd[["new"]], lvl_sd[["norep"]]))
fr <- rbind(data.frame(reg_tab[, c("comparison", "region", "definition")], kind = "absolute density",
                       est = reg_tab$ratio, lo = reg_tab$ratio_lo, hi = reg_tab$ratio_hi, glmm = reg_tab$glmm_ratio),
            data.frame(reg_tab[, c("comparison", "region", "definition")],
                       kind = "relative to each dataset's overall density (shape)",
                       est = reg_tab$shape_ratio, lo = reg_tab$shape_lo, hi = reg_tab$shape_hi,
                       glmm = reg_tab$glmm_shape_ratio))
fr$definition <- factor(fr$definition, levels = rev(unique(reg_tab$definition)))
fr$kind <- factor(fr$kind, levels = unique(fr$kind))
col_cmp <- c("NEW (all) / OLD" = COL[["new"]], "NEW without reprints / OLD" = COL[["norep"]])
pr <- ggplot(fr, aes(est, definition, colour = comparison)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, colour = INK2, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi), orientation = "y", width = 0.3, linewidth = 0.6,
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  geom_point(aes(glmm, definition), shape = 5, size = 2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
             show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~kind, ncol = 2) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(0.5, 0.67, 0.8, 1, 1.25, 1.5, 2)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = col_cmp) +
  labs(x = "NEW / OLD RAC density (log scale)", y = NULL,
       title = "The data by region: NEW / OLD RAC density without a model",
       subtitle = wrap_txt(paste(sprintf("Dots and bars: the data and 95%% whole-shoe bootstrap intervals (B = %d).", B_reg),
                                 "Open diamonds: the ratio implied by the GLMM maps on the common basis",
                                 "(the same region, each dataset's own contact pixels). rel: position across the",
                                 "prototype's half-width (-1 left edge, 1 right edge)."), 14),
       caption = wrap_txt(paste("Regions overlap (the rims lie inside the forefoot sides, the inner and edge parts",
                                "inside the heel bottom). Shape: each density divided by its dataset's overall RAC",
                                "density, so a common level difference cancels."), 14)) +
  theme_t6() + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8))
save_fig("empirical_regions", 14, 8.5, function() print(pr))
```

```{r t6_maps_asdrawn}
# the maps as step 4 draws them (MEAN_OFFSET and exp(-sigma^2/2) of each
# dataset; known issue K3): their levels are not comparable (plan F81)
asdrawn <- lapply(c(old = "glmm_old", new = "glmm_new"), function(nm) {
  ds <- ds_of(nm)
  f <- FIT[[nm]]
  t6_step4_map(f, f$spec, G, MEAN_OFFSET[[ds]], f$sigma2_step4)
})
zl <- range(unlist(asdrawn), na.rm = TRUE)
lr_ad <- log2(asdrawn$new / asdrawn$old)
lr_cal <- log2(as_mat(MAPS$glmm_new$dens) / as_mat(MAPS$glmm_old$dens))
rl <- c(-1, 1) * max(abs(c(lr_ad, lr_cal)), na.rm = TRUE)
ad_note <- paste("Left two maps share one scale. The two ratio maps differ only by a constant factor: the shape is",
                 "the same, the level is not.")
save_fig("intensity_maps_asdrawn", 13, 7.2, function() {
  layout(matrix(c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 5, 6, 6), 2, byrow = TRUE), heights = c(1, 0.13))
  par(oma = header_oma(ad_note))
  draw_map(asdrawn$old, zl, SEQ, "OLD, as step 4 draws it", sprintf("sigma^2 %.3f, MEAN_OFFSET %.3f",
           FIT$glmm_old$sigma2_step4, MEAN_OFFSET[["old"]]), axes = TRUE)
  draw_map(asdrawn$new, zl, SEQ, "NEW, as step 4 draws it", sprintf("sigma^2 %.3f, MEAN_OFFSET %.3f",
           FIT$glmm_new$sigma2_step4, MEAN_OFFSET[["new"]]))
  draw_map(lr_ad, rl, DIV, "NEW / OLD as drawn", sprintf("median %.2f", median(2^lr_ad, na.rm = TRUE)))
  draw_map(lr_cal, rl, DIV, "NEW / OLD calibrated", sprintf("median %.2f", median(2^lr_cal, na.rm = TRUE)))
  draw_bar(zl, SEQ, "step 4's intensity: -log(1 - p) x exp(-sigma^2/2), p from the log-odds + MEAN_OFFSET")
  draw_bar(rl, DIV, "NEW / OLD (log scale)", at = ratio_at,
           labels = ratio_lab[ratio_at >= rl[1] & ratio_at <= rl[2]])
  fig_header("GLMM maps as the pipeline draws them: the levels differ through exp(-sigma^2/2) and MEAN_OFFSET (K3, D-009)",
             ad_note)
})
cat(sprintf("as drawn: map means OLD %.6f, NEW %.6f (ratio %.3f); calibrated means per 1,000 contact px OLD %.3f, NEW %.3f (ratio %.3f)\n",
            mean(asdrawn$old, na.rm = TRUE), mean(asdrawn$new, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean(asdrawn$new, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(asdrawn$old, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean(MAPS$glmm_old$dens, na.rm = TRUE), mean(MAPS$glmm_new$dens, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean(MAPS$glmm_new$dens, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(MAPS$glmm_old$dens, na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("as-drawn / calibrated ratio map: min %.4f, max %.4f (a constant up to the -log(1 - p) curvature)\n",
            min(2^(lr_ad - lr_cal), na.rm = TRUE), max(2^(lr_ad - lr_cal), na.rm = TRUE)))
```

```{r t6_maps_sensitivity}
variants <- list(
  list(key = "step3", lab = "own step-3 knots (main)", glmm = c("glmm_old", "glmm_new"), cml = c("cml_old", "cml_new")),
  list(key = "oldbasis", lab = "common basis: NEW on OLD's knots", glmm = c("glmm_old", "glmm_new_ob"),
       cml = c("cml_old", "cml_new_ob")),
  list(key = "full", lab = "full tensor (main effects + interaction)", glmm = c("glmm_full_old", "glmm_full_new"),
       cml = c("cml_full_old", "cml_full_new")),
  list(key = "fineY", lab = "finer y knots, each its own", glmm = c("glmm_fineY0_old", "glmm_fineY0_new"),
       cml = c("cml_fineY_old", "cml_fineY_new")),
  list(key = "fineYcommon", lab = "finer y knots, common (OLD's)", glmm = c("glmm_fineY0_old", "glmm_fineYold0_new"),
       cml = c("cml_fineY_old", "cml_fineYold_new")),
  list(key = "norep", lab = "NEW without the reprinted shoes", glmm = c("glmm_old", "glmm_norep_new"),
       cml = c("cml_old", "cml_norep_new")),
  list(key = "groupB", lab = "NEW without group A (group B only)", glmm = c("glmm_old", "glmm_groupB_new"),

}
```
