```{r t6_maps_sensitivity}
}
# a variant enters a model's figures and tables only when both its fits exist
# (always, except in a T6_ALLOW_MISSING development run)
variants_of <- function(model) {
  ok <- Filter(function(v) have(v[[model]]), variants)
  gone <- setdiff(vapply(variants, function(v) v$key, ""), vapply(ok, function(v) v$key, ""))
  if (length(gone)) {
    # in a run without T6_ALLOW_MISSING every required fit exists, so a
    # missing variant can only be one of the slow exact CMLs
    if (allow_missing) {
      skipped <<- c(skipped, paste(model, "variant", gone))
    } else {
      slow_missing <<- c(slow_missing, paste(model, "variant", gone))
    }
  }
  ok
}
sens_ratio <- function(model) {
  lapply(variants_of(model), function(v) {
    p <- v[[model]]
    lr <- log2(MAPS[[p[2]]]$dens / MAPS[[p[1]]]$dens)
    z <- (log(MAPS[[p[2]]]$dens) - log(MAPS[[p[1]]]$dens)) /
      sqrt(MAPS[[p[1]]]$se_log^2 + MAPS[[p[2]]]$se_log^2)
    list(lr = lr, z = z, v = v, pair = p)
  })
}
vs_lab <- function(la, lb) {
  sa <- sub("^OLD ", "", la)
  sb <- sub("^NEW ", "", lb)
  if (identical(sa, sb)) paste("OLD vs NEW", sa) else paste(la, "vs", lb)
}
sens_fig <- function(model, model_lab) {
  S <- sens_ratio(model)
  # ratios beyond 0.5-2 (corners and edges of the richer bases) at the end colours
  rl <- c(-1, 1) * min(1, max(sapply(S, function(s) max(abs(s$lr), na.rm = TRUE))))
  sens_note <- paste("Black lines: pointwise |z| = 1.96 (model-based, not adjusted for multiplicity or for the",
                     "dependence of RACs within a shoe). Grey: fewer than 10 RAC pixels of OLD or NEW within the",
                     "21 x 21-pixel box. Last panel: the same ratio from the data, without a model.")
  save_fig(paste("ratio_maps_sensitivity", model, sep = "_"), 15, 9.5, function() {
    layout(matrix(c(1:8, 9, 9, 9, 9), 3, byrow = TRUE), heights = c(1, 1, 0.12))
    par(oma = header_oma(sens_note))
    for (k in seq_along(S)) {
      s <- S[[k]]
      draw_map(as_mat(s$lr), rl, DIV, s$v$lab, vs_lab(FIT[[s$pair[1]]]$label, FIT[[s$pair[2]]]$label),
               z_contour = as_mat(s$z), shade = sparse, axes = k %in% c(1, 5))
    }
    missing_lab <- setdiff(vapply(variants, function(v) v$lab, ""), vapply(S, function(s) s$v$lab, ""))
    for (pad in seq_len(7 - length(S))) {
      plot.new()
      if (pad == 1) {
        text(0.5, 0.5, paste(c("not shown (fit missing):", missing_lab,
                               if (model == "cml") "the exact CMLs on the finer y basis need 3.5 GB each;" else NULL,
                               if (model == "cml") "the GLMM figure has the finer-y variants" else NULL),
                             collapse = "\n"), cex = 0.85, col = INK2)
      }
    }
    le <- log2(EMP$new$dens / EMP$old$dens)
    le[sparse | !mask_mat] <- NA
    draw_map(le, rl, DIV, "data: empirical NEW / OLD", "all shoes, RAC pixels / contact pixels in a 21 x 21 box",
             shade = sparse)
    draw_bar(rl, DIV, "NEW / OLD (log scale): red = NEW higher, blue = OLD higher; grey: little data; beyond 0.5-2 at the end colours",
             at = ratio_at, labels = ratio_lab[ratio_at >= rl[1] - 1e-9 & ratio_at <= rl[2] + 1e-9])
    fig_header(sprintf("%s: the NEW / OLD ratio of the calibrated maps under the plan's sensitivities", model_lab),
               sens_note)
  })
  do.call(rbind, lapply(S, function(s) {
    r <- 2^s$lr[inside]
    data.frame(model = model, variant = s$v$key, label = s$v$lab, old_fit = s$pair[1], new_fit = s$pair[2],
               ratio_p5 = q(r, 0.05), ratio_median = median(r), ratio_p95 = q(r, 0.95),
               share_z_above = mean(s$z[inside] > 1.96), share_z_below = mean(s$z[inside] < -1.96),
               share_outside_0.8_1.25 = mean(r < 0.8 | r > 1.25),
               share_outside_0.8_1.25_supported = mean((r < 0.8 | r > 1.25)[!sparse[mask_mat]]))
  }))
}
sens_tab <- rbind(sens_fig("cml", "Conditional ML (CML)"), sens_fig("glmm", "Random effects (GLMM)"))
print(sens_tab, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)

# how far the Efron approximation of the CML (used for the cluster-robust
# check) moves the map from the exact CML on the same basis (OLD's step-3
# knots): calibrated densities over the prototype
ef_map <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c(old = "cml_old", new = "cml_new_ob"), function(nm) {
  f <- FIT[[nm]]
  k <- if (nm == "cml_old") "old" else "new"
  fe <- f
  stopifnot(identical(names(EF[[k]]$coef), names(f$coef)))
  fe$coef <- EF[[k]]$coef
  ds <- ds_of(nm)
  ce <- t6_calibration(fe, fe$spec, data_of(fe, ds), CODES[[ds]], PC[[ds]])
  de <- 1000 * t6_density(fe, fe$spec, G$x[inside], G$y[inside], ce, se = FALSE)$density
  r <- de / MAPS[[nm]]$dens[inside]
  data.frame(fit = nm, max_abs_coef_diff = max(abs(fe$coef - f$coef)), efron_over_exact_p5 = q(r, 0.05),
             median = median(r), p95 = q(r, 0.95), min = min(r), max = max(r))
}))
print(ef_map, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)
out_csv(ef_map, "efron_vs_exact_cml")
```

## (e) Confidence intervals at the cuts

```{r t6_cuts}
cut_df <- function(nm, variant, model) {
  ds <- ds_of(nm)
  do.call(rbind, lapply(cut_rows, function(r) {
    cols <- which(mask_mat[r, ])
    k <- (r - 1) * G$ncol + cols
    m <- MAPS[[nm]]
    data.frame(dataset = toupper(ds), fit = nm, variant = variant, model = model, row = r,
               y = G$ys[r], col = cols, new_x = G$xs[cols], est = m$dens[k],
               lo = m$dens[k] * exp(-1.96 * m$se_log[k]), hi = m$dens[k] * exp(1.96 * m$se_log[k]))
  }))
}
CUTS <- rbind(
  do.call(rbind, lapply(variants_of("glmm"), function(v) {
    rbind(cut_df(v$glmm[1], v$key, "GLMM"), cut_df(v$glmm[2], v$key, "GLMM"))
  })),
  do.call(rbind, lapply(variants_of("cml"), function(v) {
    rbind(cut_df(v$cml[1], v$key, "CML"), cut_df(v$cml[2], v$key, "CML"))
  })))
out_csv(CUTS, "ci_cuts")

sep_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(CUTS, list(CUTS$variant, CUTS$model, CUTS$row), drop = TRUE), function(s) {
  o <- s[s$dataset == "OLD", ]

             new_above = mean(n$lo > o$hi), new_below = mean(n$hi < o$lo),
             median_ratio = median(n$est / o$est), max_ratio = max(n$est / o$est),
             min_ratio = min(n$est / o$est),
             old_band_halfwidth = median((o$hi - o$lo) / (2 * o$est)),
             new_band_halfwidth = median((n$hi - n$lo) / (2 * n$est)))
}))

# the cuts on the common basis with shoe-bootstrap bands (95% percentile
# intervals of the draws; T6 review fixes): for the absolute density each
# draw is recalibrated on its own resampled shoes (the band includes the
# sampling error of the dataset's overall RAC density); for the shape each
# draw is divided by its own observed density and the estimate by the
# dataset's observed density (relative density, 1 = the dataset's average),
# beside the model-based band of the same relative density (RAC total
# fixed, so also a band of the shape); the RAC-total-fixed bootstrap band of
# the first T6 run is kept in the table for the record
cut_boot <- function(k) {
  nm <- boot_fit[[k]]
  f <- FIT[[nm]]
  ds <- ds_of(nm)
  rows <- t6_cal_rows(f, D[[ds]], CODES[[ds]], PC[[ds]])
  pts <- do.call(rbind, lapply(cut_rows, function(r) data.frame(row = r, col = which(mask_mat[r, ]))))
  kk <- (pts$row - 1) * G$ncol + pts$col
  b <- t6_logdens_boot(f, rows, t6_boot_draws(BOOT[[k]], f), G$x[kk], G$y[kk], ids = t6_boot_ids(BOOT[[k]]),
                       kinds = c("fixed", "resampled", "shape"), quantiles = TRUE)
  m <- MAPS[[nm]]
  obs <- 1000 * CAL[[nm]]$observed_density
  data.frame(series = c(old = "OLD", new_ob = "NEW (all)", norep = "NEW without reprints")[[k]],
             fit = nm, row = pts$row, col = pts$col, new_x = G$xs[pts$col], est = m$dens[kk],
             lo_boot = 1000 * exp(b$resampled$q_lo), hi_boot = 1000 * exp(b$resampled$q_hi),
             se_log_boot = b$resampled$sd,
             observed_density = obs, rel_est = m$dens[kk] / obs,
             rel_lo_boot = exp(b$shape$q_lo), rel_hi_boot = exp(b$shape$q_hi), se_log_boot_shape = b$shape$sd,
             rel_lo_model = m$dens[kk] * exp(-1.96 * m$se_log[kk]) / obs,
             rel_hi_model = m$dens[kk] * exp(1.96 * m$se_log[kk]) / obs, se_log_model = m$se_log[kk],
             lo_boot_fixedN = 1000 * exp(b$fixed$q_lo), hi_boot_fixedN = 1000 * exp(b$fixed$q_hi),
             se_log_boot_fixedN = b$fixed$sd)
}
CB <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(BOOT), cut_boot))
if (!is.null(CB)) {
  out_csv(CB, "ci_cuts_bootstrap")
  CB$row_lab <- factor(vapply(CB$row, row_lab, ""), levels = vapply(cut_rows, row_lab, ""))
  ser <- c("OLD", "NEW (all)", "NEW without reprints")
  CB$series <- factor(CB$series, levels = ser)
  col_ser <- c(COL[["old"]], COL[["new"]], COL[["norep"]])
  names(col_ser) <- ser
  b_lab <- paste(unique(vapply(names(BOOT), function(k) nrow(BOOT[[k]]$draws), 0L)), collapse = "/")
  k8_old <- FIT$glmm_old$spec$bknots_x[1]
  pb <- ggplot(CB, aes(new_x, est, colour = series, fill = series)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo_boot, ymax = hi_boot), alpha = 0.18, colour = NA) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = k8_old, colour = INK2, linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.5) +
    facet_wrap(~row_lab, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = col_ser[levels(droplevels(CB$series))]) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = col_ser[levels(droplevels(CB$series))]) +
    labs(x = sprintf("standardized x, new_x (coordinate units; 1 unit = %g prototype pixels)", px_per_unit),
         y = "RAC pixels per 1,000 contact pixels",
         title = "CI cuts on the common basis: absolute density, shoe-bootstrap 95% bands",
         subtitle = wrap_txt(paste("GLMM; NEW refitted on OLD's step-3 knots. Shaded: bootstrap band (whole shoes resampled,",
                                   sprintf("B = %s), each draw recalibrated on its own resampled shoes, so the band", b_lab),
                                   "includes the sampling error of each dataset's overall RAC density (level and shape)."), 10),
         caption = wrap_txt(paste("Overlapping 95% bands of two independent estimates do not mean a non-significant",
                                  "difference (the pointwise z of the difference is in the text). Dotted vertical: the",
                                  "K8 left edge (log-odds pinned there). The shape alone: figure ci_cuts_commonbasis_shape_boot."), 10)) +
    theme_t6()
  save_fig("ci_cuts_commonbasis_boot", 10, 10, function() print(pb))
  ps_cut <- ggplot(CB, aes(new_x, rel_est, colour = series, fill = series)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, colour = INK2, linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = rel_lo_boot, ymax = rel_hi_boot), alpha = 0.18, colour = NA) +
    geom_line(aes(y = rel_lo_model), linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "22") +
    geom_line(aes(y = rel_hi_model), linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "22") +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = k8_old, colour = INK2, linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.5) +
    facet_wrap(~row_lab, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = col_ser[levels(droplevels(CB$series))]) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = col_ser[levels(droplevels(CB$series))]) +
    labs(x = sprintf("standardized x, new_x (coordinate units; 1 unit = %g prototype pixels)", px_per_unit),
         y = "relative RAC density (1 = the dataset's overall density)",
         title = "CI cuts on the common basis: shape only, shoe-bootstrap 95% bands",
         subtitle = wrap_txt(paste("Each density divided by its dataset's observed RAC density, so a level difference",
                                   sprintf("cancels. Shaded: bootstrap band (B = %s), each draw divided by its own", b_lab),
                                   "resampled observed density; dashed: the model-based band of the same fit."), 10),
         caption = wrap_txt(paste("Observed RAC density per 1,000 contact pixels:",
                                  paste0(paste(sprintf("%s %.3f", levels(droplevels(CB$series)),
                                                       tapply(CB$observed_density, droplevels(CB$series),
                                                              function(v) v[1])),
                                               collapse = ", "), "."),
                                  "Dotted vertical: the K8 left edge."), 10)) +
    theme_t6()
  save_fig("ci_cuts_commonbasis_shape_boot", 10, 10, function() print(ps_cut))
  cb_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(CB, list(CB$series, CB$row), drop = TRUE), function(s) {
    data.frame(series = s$series[1], row = s$row[1], columns = nrow(s),
               shape_boot_over_model_width_median = median((s$rel_hi_boot - s$rel_lo_boot) /
                                                             (s$rel_hi_model - s$rel_lo_model)),
               shape_boot_over_model_width_max = max((s$rel_hi_boot - s$rel_lo_boot) / (s$rel_hi_model - s$rel_lo_model)),
               level_over_shape_boot_width_median = median((s$hi_boot - s$lo_boot) / s$est /
                                                             (s$rel_hi_boot - s$rel_lo_boot) * s$rel_est),
               fixedN_boot_over_model_width_median = median((s$hi_boot_fixedN - s$lo_boot_fixedN) /
                                                              (s$rel_hi_model - s$rel_lo_model) / s$observed_density))
  }))
  sep_boot <- do.call(rbind, lapply(intersect(c("NEW (all)", "NEW without reprints"), CB$series), function(sr) {
    do.call(rbind, lapply(cut_rows, function(r) {
      o <- CB[CB$series == "OLD" & CB$row == r, ]
      n <- CB[CB$series == sr & CB$row == r, ]
      stopifnot(identical(o$col, n$col))
      z_lvl <- (log(n$est) - log(o$est)) / sqrt(n$se_log_boot^2 + o$se_log_boot^2)
      z_shp <- (log(n$rel_est) - log(o$rel_est)) / sqrt(n$se_log_boot_shape^2 + o$se_log_boot_shape^2)
      data.frame(new = sr, row = r,
                 level_bands_new_above = mean(n$lo_boot > o$hi_boot), level_bands_new_below = mean(n$hi_boot < o$lo_boot),
                 level_z_above = mean(z_lvl > 1.96), level_z_below = mean(z_lvl < -1.96),
                 shape_bands_new_above = mean(n$rel_lo_boot > o$rel_hi_boot),
                 shape_bands_new_below = mean(n$rel_hi_boot < o$rel_lo_boot),
                 shape_z_above = mean(z_shp > 1.96), shape_z_below = mean(z_shp < -1.96),
                 fixedN_bands_new_above = mean(n$lo_boot_fixedN > o$hi_boot_fixedN),
                 fixedN_bands_new_below = mean(n$hi_boot_fixedN < o$lo_boot_fixedN),
                 model_bands_new_above = mean(n$rel_lo_model * n$observed_density > o$rel_hi_model * o$observed_density),
                 model_bands_new_below = mean(n$rel_hi_model * n$observed_density < o$rel_lo_model * o$observed_density),
                 median_ratio = median(n$est / o$est), median_shape_ratio = median(n$rel_est / o$rel_est))
    }))
  }))
  print(cb_tab, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)
  if (!is.null(sep_boot)) {
    print(sep_boot, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)
    cb_tab <- merge(cb_tab, sep_boot, by.x = c("series", "row"), by.y = c("new", "row"), all.x = TRUE)
  }
  out_csv(cb_tab, "ci_cuts_bootstrap_summary")
  # at OLD's forefoot peak (the column of row 110 nearest to OLD's maximum)
  o110 <- CB[CB$series == "OLD" & CB$row == 110, ]
  jpk <- which.max(o110$est)
  for (sr in levels(droplevels(CB$series))) {
    s <- CB[CB$series == sr & CB$row == 110, ][jpk, ]
    zl <- (log(s$est) - log(o110$est[jpk])) / sqrt(s$se_log_boot^2 + o110$se_log_boot[jpk]^2)
    zs <- (log(s$rel_est) - log(o110$rel_est[jpk])) / sqrt(s$se_log_boot_shape^2 + o110$se_log_boot_shape[jpk]^2)
    cat(sprintf(paste("row 110 at OLD's peak, new_x %.4f, %s: %.2f [%.2f, %.2f] per 1,000 contact px (fixed N [%.2f, %.2f]);",
                      "relative %.3f [%.3f, %.3f]; vs OLD z %.2f (absolute), %.2f (shape)\n"),
                s$new_x, sr, s$est, s$lo_boot, s$hi_boot, s$lo_boot_fixedN, s$hi_boot_fixedN, s$rel_est,
                s$rel_lo_boot, s$rel_hi_boot, zl, zs))
  }
}
```

## Naomi's 14 areas: within- and between-area ratios

```{r t6_areas}
AREA <- t6_area_of_grid(G, mirror = TRUE)
AREA_M <- t6_area_of_grid(G, mirror = FALSE)
AREA[!inside] <- NA
AREA_M[!inside] <- NA
stopifnot(identical(sort(unique(AREA[inside])), 1:14), identical(sort(unique(AREA_M[inside])), 1:14))
# the meeting's numbers (scratch within_region.R): the committed OLD GLMM,
# -log(1 - p) with p from the log-odds + MEAN_OFFSET, areas applied to x
# without the mirror
f <- FIT$glmm_old
lam <- -log(1 - plogis(t6_eta(f, f$spec, G$x, G$y, mean_offset = MEAN_OFFSET[["old"]])))
lam[!inside] <- NA
meet <- t6_area_stats(lam, AREA_M)
cat(sprintf("meeting reproduction (no mirror): between %.3f; within p90/p10 max %.3f (areas %s); max/min max %.3f (areas %s)\n",
            max(meet$mean) / min(meet$mean), max(meet$ratio_p90_p10),
            paste(meet$area[order(-meet$ratio_p90_p10)][1:2], collapse = ", "),
            max(meet$ratio_max_min), paste(meet$area[order(-meet$ratio_max_min)][1:2], collapse = ", ")))
area_point <- function(nm, area) {
  s <- t6_area_stats(MAPS[[nm]]$dens, area)
  s$between <- max(s$mean) / min(s$mean)
  s
}
# the ratios over draws of the coefficients: model-based N(b, V) draws
# (B = 1,000, the OLD profile's seed set here, so the first four fits get the
# draws of the first T6 run) or, where a fit has one, its shoe-bootstrap
# draws (T6 review fixes: the map SEs are 1.2-1.35 times larger under the
# bootstrap). The ratios are scale-free, so the calibration level does not
# enter.
set.seed(P_old$r$seed)
area_draws_model <- function(nm, B = 1000) {
  f <- FIT[[nm]]
  if (f$feature == "CML_MODEL") {
    b <- c(0, f$coef)
    V <- rbind(0, cbind(0, f$vcov))
  } else {
    b <- f$coef
    V <- f$vcov
  }
  R <- chol(V + diag(1e-12, nrow(V)))
  t(vapply(seq_len(B), function(k) b + as.vector(crossprod(R, stats::rnorm(length(b)))), numeric(length(b))))
}
area_sim <- function(nm, area, draws) {
  f <- FIT[[nm]]
  ok <- inside & !is.na(area)
  X1 <- cbind(1, t6_design(f$spec, G$x[ok], G$y[ok]))
  stopifnot(ncol(draws) == ncol(X1))
  a <- area[ok]
  idx <- split(seq_along(a), a)
  out <- vector("list", nrow(draws))
  for (k in seq_len(nrow(draws))) {
    lam <- exp(as.vector(X1 %*% draws[k, ]))
    mu <- vapply(idx, function(i) mean(lam[i]), 0)
    qq <- vapply(idx, function(i) {
      v <- stats::quantile(lam[i], c(0.1, 0.9), names = FALSE)
      c(v[2] / v[1], max(lam[i]) / min(lam[i]))
    }, c(0, 0))
    out[[k]] <- c(between = max(mu) / min(mu), mu / mean(lam), qq[1, ], qq[2, ])
  }
  do.call(rbind, out)
}
# the fits by basis; the shoe bootstraps that exist for them
area_fits <- c(glmm_old = "step-3 (OLD's own = common basis)", glmm_new = "step-3, NEW's own knots",
               cml_old = "step-3 (OLD's own = common basis)", cml_new = "step-3, NEW's own knots",
               glmm_new_ob = "step-3, common basis (OLD's knots)", glmm_norep_new = "step-3, common basis (OLD's knots)",
               glmm_full_old = "full tensor (no K8 pin), own knots", glmm_full_new = "full tensor (no K8 pin), own knots",
               glmm_fineY0_old = "finer y (nAGQ 0), own knots", glmm_fineY0_new = "finer y (nAGQ 0), own knots")
area_fits <- area_fits[names(area_fits) %in% names(MAPS)]
area_boot <- list(glmm_old = BOOT$old, glmm_new_ob = BOOT$new_ob, glmm_norep_new = BOOT$norep,
                  glmm_full_old = BOOT_FULL$old, glmm_full_new = BOOT_FULL$new)
area_boot <- area_boot[!vapply(area_boot, is.null, TRUE) & names(area_boot) %in% names(area_fits)]
model_first <- intersect(c("glmm_old", "glmm_new", "cml_old", "cml_new"), names(area_fits))
model_sims <- c(model_first, intersect(c("glmm_full_old", "glmm_full_new", "glmm_fineY0_old", "glmm_fineY0_new",
                                         "glmm_new_ob", "glmm_norep_new"), names(area_fits)))
t_area <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
SIM <- list()
for (nm in model_sims) SIM[[paste(nm, "model", sep = "|")]] <- area_sim(nm, AREA, area_draws_model(nm))
for (nm in names(area_boot)) {
  SIM[[paste(nm, "bootstrap", sep = "|")]] <- area_sim(nm, AREA, t6_boot_draws(area_boot[[nm]], FIT[[nm]]))
}
cat(sprintf("area simulations: %d fit x method combinations, %.0f s\n", length(SIM), proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - t_area))
area_rows <- function(nm, method) {
  s <- area_point(nm, AREA)
  sim <- SIM[[paste(nm, method, sep = "|")]]
  K <- nrow(s)
  ci <- function(j) apply(sim[, j, drop = FALSE], 2, stats::quantile, c(0.025, 0.975))
  rel <- ci(1 + seq_len(K))
  wit <- ci(1 + K + seq_len(K))
  mm <- ci(1 + 2 * K + seq_len(K))
  bt <- stats::quantile(sim[, 1], c(0.025, 0.975))
  wmax <- stats::quantile(apply(sim[, 1 + K + seq_len(K), drop = FALSE], 1, max), c(0.025, 0.975))
  data.frame(fit = nm, dataset = toupper(ds_of(nm)), model = FIT[[nm]]$feature, basis = area_fits[[nm]],
             interval = if (method == "bootstrap") "shoe bootstrap" else "model-based N(b, V)", draws = nrow(sim),
             s, rel_mean = s$mean / mean(MAPS[[nm]]$dens[inside]),
             rel_mean_lo = rel[1, ], rel_mean_hi = rel[2, ],
             ratio_p90_p10_lo = wit[1, ], ratio_p90_p10_hi = wit[2, ],
             ratio_max_min_lo = mm[1, ], ratio_max_min_hi = mm[2, ],
             between_lo = bt[[1]], between_hi = bt[[2]],
             within_p90_p10_max_lo = wmax[[1]], within_p90_p10_max_hi = wmax[[2]])
}
area_all <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(SIM), function(key) {
  p <- strsplit(key, "|", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  area_rows(p[1], p[2])
}))
# per fit the preferred intervals: the shoe bootstrap where it exists
area_tab <- area_all[area_all$interval == "shoe bootstrap" |
                       !area_all$fit %in% area_all$fit[area_all$interval == "shoe bootstrap"], ]
print(area_tab[area_tab$fit %in% c("glmm_full_old", "glmm_full_new"),
               c("fit", "area", "pixels", "rel_mean", "rel_mean_lo", "rel_mean_hi",
                 "ratio_p90_p10", "ratio_p90_p10_lo", "ratio_p90_p10_hi", "ratio_max_min")],
      digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)
meet_rows <- cbind(fit = "glmm_old_meeting", dataset = "OLD", model = "NEW_X_NS_XY",
                   basis = "step-3 (committed OLD GLMM, as the meeting script)", interval = NA, draws = NA,
                   meet, between = max(meet$mean) / min(meet$mean),
                   rel_mean = meet$mean / mean(lam, na.rm = TRUE), rel_mean_lo = NA, rel_mean_hi = NA,
                   ratio_p90_p10_lo = NA, ratio_p90_p10_hi = NA, ratio_max_min_lo = NA,
                   ratio_max_min_hi = NA, between_lo = NA, between_hi = NA,
                   within_p90_p10_max_lo = NA, within_p90_p10_max_hi = NA)
out_csv(rbind(cbind(variant = "mirrored (correct)", area_all),
              cbind(variant = "not mirrored (meeting script)", meet_rows)), "areas14")
ab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(area_all, list(area_all$fit, area_all$interval), drop = TRUE), function(s) {
  data.frame(fit = s$fit[1], dataset = s$dataset[1], model = s$model[1], basis = s$basis[1],
             interval = s$interval[1], draws = s$draws[1],
             between = s$between[1], between_lo = s$between_lo[1], between_hi = s$between_hi[1],
             between_areas = paste(s$area[which.max(s$mean)], s$area[which.min(s$mean)], sep = "/"),
             within_p90_p10_max = max(s$ratio_p90_p10),
             within_p90_p10_max_lo = s$within_p90_p10_max_lo[1], within_p90_p10_max_hi = s$within_p90_p10_max_hi[1],
             within_p90_p10_max_areas = paste(s$area[order(-s$ratio_p90_p10)][1:2], collapse = ","),
             within_max_min_max = max(s$ratio_max_min),
             within_max_min_areas = paste(s$area[order(-s$ratio_max_min)][1:2], collapse = ","),
             areas_within_p90_p10_ge_between = sum(s$ratio_p90_p10 >= s$between[1]))
}))
ab <- ab[order(match(ab$fit, names(area_fits)), ab$interval), ]
print(ab, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)
out_csv(ab, "areas14_summary")
```

```{r t6_area_figure}
area_cent <- function(a) {
  k <- sort(unique(a[!is.na(a)]))
  list(k = k, cx = vapply(k, function(j) mean(G$x[which(a == j)]), 0),
       cy = vapply(k, function(j) mean(G$y[which(a == j)]), 0), mat = as_mat(a))
}
AC <- area_cent(AREA)
# the figure shows the full-tensor maps (no K8 pin) with their shoe-bootstrap
# intervals (T6 review fixes); every basis is in areas14_summary
fig_fits <- c(OLD = "glmm_full_old", NEW = "glmm_full_new")
if (!all(fig_fits %in% area_tab$fit)) fig_fits <- c(OLD = "glmm_old", NEW = "glmm_new")
fig_int <- unique(area_tab$interval[area_tab$fit %in% fig_fits])
zl <- range(c(MAPS[[fig_fits[["OLD"]]]]$dens, MAPS[[fig_fits[["NEW"]]]]$dens), na.rm = TRUE)
dot_panel <- function(var, lo, hi, xlab, title, log = FALSE, ref = NULL) {
  par(mar = c(3.6, 3.2, 2.6, 0.8))
  s <- area_tab[area_tab$fit %in% fig_fits, ]
  rng <- range(c(s[[lo]], s[[hi]], s[[var]], ref), na.rm = TRUE)
  plot(NA, xlim = rng, ylim = c(0.5, 14.5), yaxt = "n", xlab = "", ylab = "", log = if (log) "x" else "",
       bty = "n", col.axis = INK2, cex.axis = 0.75)
  abline(h = 1:14, col = GRID_COL, lwd = 0.5)
  if (!is.null(ref)) abline(v = ref, col = INK2, lty = 2)
  for (ds in c("OLD", "NEW")) {
    t <- s[s$fit == fig_fits[[ds]], ]
    off <- if (ds == "OLD") 0.14 else -0.14
    segments(t[[lo]], t$area + off, t[[hi]], t$area + off, col = col_ds[[ds]], lwd = 1.6)
    points(t[[var]], t$area + off, pch = 19, col = col_ds[[ds]], cex = 0.9)
  }
  axis(2, at = 1:14, labels = 1:14, las = 1, cex.axis = 0.75, col.axis = INK)
  mtext("area", side = 2, line = 2.2, cex = 0.65, col = INK2)
  mtext(xlab, side = 1, line = 2.3, cex = 0.65, col = INK)
  title(main = title, cex.main = 0.95, col.main = INK, line = 1.2)
  legend("bottomright", legend = c(lab_ds[["OLD"]], lab_ds[["NEW"]]), col = col_ds, pch = 19, lwd = 1.6,
         bty = "n", cex = 0.7, text.col = INK)
}

  draw_bar(zl, SEQ, "RAC pixels per 1,000 contact pixels (both maps)")
```

```{r t6_random_cml}
rc <- lapply(c(old = "old", new = "new"), function(ds) {
  a <- MAPS[[paste("glmm", ds, sep = "_")]]$dens
  b <- MAPS[[paste("cml", ds, sep = "_")]]$dens
  100 * (a - b) / b
})
```
